deine aufgaben

Du liebst Zahlen, bekommst bei einem sinkenden TACoS gute Laune und willst lernen, wie man Werbung auf Marktplätzen richtig skaliert? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bei der SNOCKS Group verantwortest du die Advertising-Kampagnen auf Amazon, Zalando, OTTO, About You & Co. und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Werbe-Euro maximal viel bewegt. Das Beste: Du musst noch kein Profi sein. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen aufsetzen: Du legst Werbekampagnen auf unseren Marktplätzen (Amazon, Zalando, OTTO, About You u. a.) an und baust sie strukturiert auf.

  • Kampagnen steuern: Du hast deine Kampagnen täglich im Blick, justierst Budgets und reagierst schnell, wenn sich etwas verändert.

  • Gebote optimieren: Du optimierst Gebote datenbasiert und findest die perfekte Balance zwischen Reichweite und Profitabilität.

  • Keywords recherchieren: Du findest heraus, wonach unsere Kund:innen wirklich suchen, und machst daraus Kampagnen, die performen.

  • Reportings bauen: Du erstellst und pflegst Reportings, leitest daraus klare Learnings ab und teilst sie mit dem Team.

dein profil

  • Berufserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Performance Marketing, E-Commerce oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Marktplatz-Advertising sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Studium: Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich E-Commerce, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du richtig Bock hast, schnell und viel zu lernen.

  • Analytisches Denken und Zahlenaffinität: Du hast starke analytische Fähigkeiten und fühlst dich im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen wohl. Excel, Google Sheets und der Einsatz von AI schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

  • Motivation: Du hast richtig Bock, eigene Ideen einzubringen und unser Advertising aufs nächste Level zu bringen.

  • Teamplayer:in: Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst dein Wissen und holst dir Feedback, statt allein vor dich hinzuwerkeln.

  • Lösungsorientiert: Wenn eine Kampagne nicht läuft, fragst du nicht einfach nur „Warum?", sondern „Was probieren wir als Nächstes?"

  • Belastbar: Auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du einen kühlen Kopf und die Prioritäten im Blick.

  • Sprache: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.



42.000 - 49.000 € / Jahr

Faktoren, die das Gehalt einer/eines Mitarbeitenden innerhalb dieser Spanne beeinflussen können sind unter anderem bisherige Erfahrung, Skills und Qualifikationen, die mit eingebracht werden und während des Bewerbungsprozesses bewertet werden.
On top profitierst du natürlich von unseren Benefits: Hier kannst du dich unter anderem auf ein eigenes Weiterbildungs- & Reisebudget sowie einen monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug freuen.

Diese Spanne spiegelt wider, was wir zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt für diese Stelle als faire Bezahlung einschätzen, kann sich durch unsere stetige Weiterentwicklung aber auch anpassen.

warum wir?

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

  • Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
  • Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt: Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.
  • Echte Flexibilität: Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.
  • Onboarding: Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.
  • Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.
  • Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun: Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.
  • Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.
  • Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!
  • Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

Senior Fund Accountant – Client Onboarding

Who is Gen II?

Gen II is a leading fund administration provider focused entirely on serving private capital asset managers and investors with a best-in-class combination of people, process, and technology. Gen II has more than $2 trillion in private fund capital assets under administration.

With offices in the US and Europe, we’re looking for do-ers, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs like you who want to make an impact in our industry, grow with us, and create a community where everyone thrives.

Careers mean more at Gen II – more opportunity, more innovation, and more ideas! You’ll have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you and work alongside some of the best people in their field. You’ll also receive training which will advance your skill set, both technically and personally allowing you to achieve your career aspirations with us. Be part of our community that recognizes achievements, promotes from within, and receive meaningful benefits which focus on your physical, mental and financial well-being.

Position Overview

The Senior Fund Accountant – Client Onboarding Team will be responsible for leading key workstreams in the onboarding and historical data migration of new clients, with ownership of more complex reconciliations and conversions. This role involves preparing and self-reviewing financial data, validating imported information, and guiding fund accountants through day-to-day execution of assigned transition tasks. The position offers increased ownership of accounting workstreams, exposure to process improvement, and a bridge toward review and supervisory responsibilities in a project-based environment.

Primary Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Convert and reconcile historical accounting data from prior administrators or systems, including more complex or higher-risk fund and entity conversions
  • Perform and self-review trial balance, capital account, and transaction reconciliations, ensuring accuracy prior to supervisor review
  • Lead the setup and validation of funds, entity, and investor information in Gen II’s accounting systems
  • Prepare and quality-check supporting schedules, workpapers, and financial statement tie-outs, including partner capital account information
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for reconciliation and data issues, escalating complex items to the Supervisor as needed
  • Provide guidance and on-the-job training to fund accountants, reviewing their work as assigned
  • Maintain and monitor transition checklists, ensuring timely completion of deliverables across assigned clients

Job Requirements, Skills, Education, and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; degree in Accounting or Finance preferred
  • 2 years of fund accounting or fund administration experience, preferably in private equity; prior transition, conversion, or onboarding experience preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Working knowledge of private-equity fund structures, allocations, and partner capital accounting
  • Experience with fund accounting systems (Intacct, Investran, Allvue, etc.) preferred
  • Effective communication and organizational abilities; able to manage multiple deliverables and competing priorities

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $100,000, in addition to a discretionary bonus and comprehensive benefits package. Please note that the actual salary offered within that range will depend on the candidate’s experience level.

Work Arrangement

All applicants applying to Gen II Fund Services, LLC must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

raw.description:
HEY YOU!

Did we just get your attention?! Well shoot, we're gonna do our best to not waste your time. ⚡️

Why KlientBoost?

At KlientBoost, we're obsessed with helping businesses grow and helping our team members do the same. We're a team of ambitious, curious, and genuinely good humans who care deeply about doing great work and having fun while doing it.

You'll have the opportunity to work with incredible clients, collaborate with talented teammates, make a direct impact on the client experience, and play a critical role in setting every partnership up for success.

If you're excited by the idea of being the person who turns a signed deal into a thriving client relationship, we'd love to meet you!


🚨Important Interview Loop Note 🚨

Quick message from Johnathan Dane, our Founder:

Because we get 300+ applicants per job posting, we don’t have time to review every single resume nor can we set up interview calls with everyone.

So instead, we ask you to apply and do a one time async video interview first (takes about 10 minutes). This video allows us to see your energy, enthusiasm, and knowledge around B2B paid ads.

If you finish this video, we promise video feedback from our Founder if we don’t move forward with you.

The Interview Loop for this role is:

1. Async Video Interview (link available HERE and in the question down below)
2. Zoom Call with Johnathan Dane (Founder and will be direct manager of this role
3. Zoom Call with Rob Childers (Senior Director of Operations)
4. Background & Reference Check

5. Offer

We're so excited to meet you 🎉

Ready to Be the First Impression of KlientBoost?

You know that moment when someone walks into a party and immediately sets the tone for the entire night?

That's this role.

We're looking for a high-energy, detail-obsessed, client-loving Head of Experimentation to become the face of the KlientBoost experience for every new client that joins us. You'll be the bridge between the Sales and Growth Teams (our client delivery team), the quarterback of the onboarding process, and the person responsible for making clients think, "Yep, we made the right decision." You'll also be constantly experimenting with better ways to drive client outcomes, improve close rates, and create a more effective onboarding experience through the use of AI, automation, Kite, creativity, and process improvement.

This role does not carry a sales quota and does not manage a long term book of business.

This isn't a project coordinator role. This isn't a note-taking role. And it's definitely not a "follow a checklist and send a few emails" role.

You'll be leading kickoff meetings, executing our paid ads "First Aid Kits," building initial campaign infrastructure, gathering critical information, solving problems before they become problems, and creating a world-class experience that gets clients excited about working with KlientBoost from day one.

If you love digital marketing, thrive in client-facing environments, can confidently lead conversations with executives, and get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction from keeping things organized and moving forward, this might be the perfect role for you…keep reading…

What You'll Do

  • Own the first 30-day client experience from signed contract through successful handoff to the Growth team.
  • Join inbound sales calls to provide paid media expertise, strategic support, and additional confidence during the sales process.
  • Lead kickoff and onboarding meetings that create excitement, confidence, and trust.
  • Execute paid ads "First Aid Kits," build initial campaign infrastructure, and ensure campaign structures, tracking, reporting, and account setups meet KlientBoost quality standards.
  • Gather, organize, and validate all onboarding assets, account access, tracking requirements, and client information.
  • Review sales handoff documentation to ensure goals, expectations, and commitments are executed accurately.
  • Identify risks, roadblocks, and missing information before they impact client timelines.
  • Manage multiple client onboardings simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Deliver a consultative, high-touch experience that makes clients excited to work with us.
  • Ensure Growth teams receive fully prepared accounts, campaigns, assets, tracking, and documentation so no additional onboarding buildout work is required after transition.
  • Partner with Sales and Growth teams to improve close rates, onboarding effectiveness, and client goal achievement through AI, automation, Kite, creativity, and process improvement.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You genuinely enjoy talking to people and building relationships.
  • You can confidently lead conversations, presentations, and meetings.
  • You communicate clearly, professionally, and proactively.
  • You can confidently navigate ad platforms, analyze results, infer meaning, and translate that into client goals.
  • You love organization and can juggle multiple moving pieces without dropping the ball.
  • You have an eye for detail and catch things others miss.
  • You take ownership and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem.
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where no two days look the same.
  • You naturally bring energy, enthusiasm, and confidence into every client and team interaction.

Experience We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience building and managing paid advertising campaigns across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
  • 2+ years of client-facing account management experience.
  • Experience in sales, client upsells, contract negotiations, or consultative client conversations.
  • Strong understanding of B2B paid media strategy and experience building campaigns that drive revenue and business growth outcomes.
  • Experience working within an agency environment is a plus.
  • Experience with Asana and HubSpot is a plus.

Critical Skills

  • High-energy and confident presence in virtual environments.
  • Deep B2B paid ads expertise across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong relationship-building and client management abilities.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Working Environment

  • Remote work environment.
  • Primarily computer-based work.
  • Frequent video meetings and client-facing interactions.
  • Fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

Benefits
🏥 100% Benefits Covered by Company (Health, Vision, Dental, Life)*
💰 Variable 401K Match – Currently up to 1%

🏖 Unlimited PTO

🏡 Work From Anywhere

🏋🏾‍♀️ $100 Monthly Wellness Stipend
🌮 $25 Friday Lunch Stipend
📚 $1,000 Annual Conference/Education Allowance

* Benefits begin the 1st of the month following your start date. The company covers the premium for the base plan, you have the option to upgrade to the plan that best fits of your stage of life or needs at additional cost to you.

Pay Information

Base Salary is $100,000 to $120,000 per year

Commission and benefits will make OTE $150,000-$170,000 per year

raw.description:
Advantmed is a leading healthcare solutions company that partners with health plans and providers to improve patient outcomes through population health, preventive care, risk adjustment, and care coordination programs. Our team is dedicated to helping members access the care they need while making a meaningful impact on healthcare quality across the United States.

Position Summary

The Team Leader is responsible for managing a team of Appointment Scheduling Specialists supporting healthcare outreach, member engagement, appointment booking, confirmations, and rescheduling activities. The role is accountable for team performance, productivity, quality, attendance, compliance, and service delivery while ensuring an exceptional member experience.

Key Responsibilities

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 10-20 Appointment Scheduling Specialists.
  • Conduct daily huddles, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.
  • Monitor real-time performance and provide immediate support when required.
  • Manage attendance, schedule adherence, and employee engagement.
  • Create action plans for underperforming employees.

Operations Management

  • Ensure daily, weekly, and monthly scheduling targets are achieved.
  • Drive appointment booking, confirmation, and conversion performance.
  • Manage workload distribution and workforce utilization.
  • Collaborate with Workforce Management, Training, QA, and Operations leadership.
  • Support implementation of new campaigns and process changes.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to HIPAA and company compliance standards.
  • Review quality scores and conduct calibration sessions.
  • Monitor call handling practices and member interactions.
  • Drive documentation accuracy and CRM compliance.

Performance Management

  • Analyse KPI trends and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for performance gaps.
  • Develop performance improvement plans for team members.
  • Prepare operational reports and present results to leadership.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact between Operations and Support Functions.
  • Partner with QA, Training, Workforce Management, and Client Services teams.
  • Escalate operational risks and implement corrective actions.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of call center experience.

﻿Accelerate Your Career in Cybersecurity

Pentera is the market leader in AI-native Security Validation, equipping enterprises with the platform to proactively test their defenses against the latest cyber attacks. Pentera proves which exposures are truly exploitable across the entire attack surface and drives remediation workflows that reduce real risk. Anchored in real-attack validation, the Pentera platform powers the full Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) cycle, from exposure discovery through prioritization, validation, and mobilization. Thousands of security teams around the world trust Pentera to close their security gaps before threat actors can exploit them.

With over 350 team members and 1,300 customers in more than 60 countries, Pentera is a growing company supported by top investors such as Insight Partners, K1, and The Blackstone Group.

If you want to grow your skills, make an impact, and be part of an innovative team, Pentera is the place for you.

The Role

Most security sales roles have you pitching fear. This one has you proving it: an AI-native platform that emulates real attacks inside a customer’s own environment - the strongest demo in cybersecurity, because the results are the customer’s own.

You’ll run your PNW territory like a business: full cycle, first touch to close, pipeline and doors you open yourself. You’ll shape how we sell, not just run the play - and what you close moves the company’s trajectory, not just your number.

We are seeking a motivated Electrical Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our growing Architectural and Engineering Design firm. This individual will support the design and development of electrical systems for K-12 and commercial projects, ensuring compliance with client needs and industry standards. The ideal candidate will be actively pursuing their Professional Engineer (PE) license and demonstrate strong technical skills and collaborative capabilities. This role involves working with multidisciplinary teams, managing project timelines, and cross-functional collaboration with architects and other engineers.

This remote position requires the individual to live in the state of Michigan with the ability to regularly travel throughout the state to client sites.

Essential Responsibilities:

Design and Development:

raw.description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

At Create Music Group, acquiring a catalog is only the beginning. The next step is turning each acquisition into a fully operational royalty business — accurately configured, scalable, and built to serve artists, partners, and rightsholders for the long term.

The Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding plays a critical role in making that happen. This leader oversees the royalty onboarding strategy for newly acquired catalogs, translating complex deal terms into clear, effective royalty structures and workflows across Create’s systems. From interpreting acquisition agreements to designing the future-state setup, this role ensures every catalog is positioned for accurate and efficient royalty administration from day one.

As a key partner to our M&A, Finance, Legal, and Royalties teams, the Senior Manager is involved early in the acquisition lifecycle—including during diligence—to identify royalty requirements, surface potential gaps, and help shape a seamless transition into Create’s platform. The role works closely with the Director of Royalties and leads a growing team responsible for bringing each onboarding strategy to life.

This is an opportunity to sit at the intersection of music rights, acquisitions, operations, and technology at a company that continues to expand its global catalog and platform. We’re looking for a leader who understands the details of royalty administration but can also see the bigger picture: how to build scalable processes, navigate complex deals, and create an exceptional foundation for every catalog that joins Create Music Group.

Responsibilities

  • Own contract-to-system royalty interpretation company-wide: rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment, and defensible workarounds where a platform cannot implement a term literally.
  • Own the Royalties Readiness Gate for incoming acquisitions. Issue the go/no-go recommendation on every acquisition before it enters statement processing, with peer review from the Senior Manager, Royalty Accounting & Operations.
  • Own the handoff packet standard for incoming acquisitions. Every acquisition handoff states plainly what is final, what is assumed, and what remains open. No acquisition transfers to operations without one.
  • Lead contractual royalty obligation analysis for acquisitions, including a written risk/reward recommendation on onboarding methodology — migrate the label into our systems, or leave it on its existing platform.
  • Represent Royalties in M&A diligence from LOI. Own the royalty section of the diligence memo and the list of closing conditions Royalties depends on.
  • Own the team's project portfolio: expense validation tooling, bulk and automated ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts, the M&A onboarding checklist, and automated metadata, contract, and payor template generation derived from statement analysis.
  • Own role-based access and configuration governance across all royalty systems. Define who may create clients, update splits, and alter contract terms — and enforce it.
  • Establish and enforce upstream intake requirements from other departments for expense, advance, and account-creation requests, so approved requests specify the opportunity, amount, and recipient before work is initiated.
  • Run prior-acquisition review: find and correct configuration and mapping errors from past integrations before they compound
  • Set, publish, and hold the KPIs for both integration and ongoing operations: time-to-royalty-ready per acquisition, post-close error rate, and Label Administration team throughput, quality, and escalation resolution at this role's level rather than the Director's.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop the Label Administration and Integration teams, including two people managers
  • Other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in music business, accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; in lieu of a degree, 5+ years of applicable royalty administration and royalty operations experience in the music industry will be considered.
  • 4+ years of relevant royalty administration or royalty operations experience
  • 2+ years of people management experience, ideally including managing other managers, or clearly ready to step into that
  • A demonstrated track record of catalog integration or onboarding — you have migrated an acquired catalog onto a platform, not just administered one already in place
  • Hands-on experience translating contract terms — rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment — into system configuration. Experience handling advanced multi-layer royalty recoupment models and cross collateralization highly desirable.
  • Experience configuring an enterprise royalty or rights-management platform (Label Engine, Curve, Vistex Music Maestro and/or Record Maestro, Counterpoint, or SR1) at a configuration level, not just day-to-day operation
  • Able to read an acquisition agreement, schedule, or exhibit and identify what it requires of a royalty system before configuration begins
  • Judgment to design a defensible workaround when a platform cannot implement a contract term literally, and to document why
  • Experience owning access and configuration governance: defining who may create clients, update splits, or alter contract terms, and holding that line across departments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including writing a recommendation that a diligence or finance audience can act on
  • Organized and accurate across concurrent acquisitions at different stages and day to day administration of onboarded catalogs and direct signings

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced royalty recoupment models and cross-collateralization
  • Experience representing a function in M&A diligence
  • Working knowledge of SQL against a cloud data warehouse: able to run and adapt a query to validate a configuration or a migration
  • Experience with template or tooling automation — metadata, contract, or payor template generation, or bulk ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts
  • Familiarity with DDEX or DSR reporting standards
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
  • Background at a major label, large independent, or distributor

Pay Scale

  • $90,000 - $120,000 USD per year
  • The final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

Fair Chance Policy

In accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications and the nature of the offense in relation to the job for which they are applying.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be responsible for managing and executing SEO work across client accounts, with a strong focus on driving organic traffic, rankings, and ultimately business results.

SEO Strategy

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies based on each client's goals, market, and competitive landscape.
  • Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities for improving organic visibility.
  • Analyze competitors and search results to find opportunities for growth.
  • Prioritize SEO work based on potential impact rather than simply checking tasks off a list.

On-Page & Content Optimization

  • Optimize existing website pages for search intent, keywords, structure, and conversions.
  • Work with content writers to improve existing content and guide the creation of new SEO-focused content.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal linking, metadata, headings, content structure, and other on-page elements.
  • Review content and SEO pages to make sure they are useful, relevant, and aligned with the overall strategy.

SEO Page Creation

  • Write SEO-focused copy for website pages and blog content when needed.
  • Create and optimize location and service pages at scale while maintaining quality and relevance.
  • Use SEO tools and research to make sure pages are targeting the right search terms and satisfying search intent.

Technical SEO

  • Perform technical SEO audits and identify issues that may be limiting organic performance.
  • Troubleshoot indexing, crawlability, site structure, redirects, metadata, and other technical SEO issues.
  • Implement on-page and technical SEO improvements directly when appropriate.
  • Work with the team to resolve issues that require additional development or technical support.

WordPress & Elementor

  • Work directly in WordPress and Elementor to make SEO and content updates.
  • Maintain page structure and formatting while making SEO improvements.
  • Ensure changes are implemented accurately and consistently across client websites.

Off Page SEO

  • Develop and execute off-page SEO strategies to improve domain authority, rankings, and local search visibility.
  • Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through link building, outreach, digital PR, and industry-specific opportunities.
  • Conduct competitor backlink analysis and identify backlink gaps and new opportunities using tools such as Ahrefs and SEMrush.
  • Manage local SEO activities, including citation building, citation cleanup, and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Monitor backlink profiles, referring domains, and link quality, identifying potentially harmful or spammy links when necessary.
  • Track and report on off-page SEO activities, progress, and results while ensuring all link-building practices follow SEO best practices.

Reporting & Performance

  • Monitor rankings, organic traffic, leads, and other relevant SEO metrics.
  • Use tools such as Google Analytics and Google Search Console to identify trends and potential issues.
  • Report meaningful findings to the team rather than simply providing numbers.
  • Use performance data to adjust strategies and identify new opportunities.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who already knows SEO and can hit the ground running.

The right person will be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, digging into data, identifying problems, and figuring out what needs to happen next. You should be able to work independently without disappearing into your own world—you'll still need to communicate clearly and keep the rest of the team informed.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within a digital marketing agency.
  • Strong understanding of keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, content optimization, and search intent.
  • Experience managing SEO across multiple client websites.
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, and BrightLocal.
  • Experience with WordPress; Elementor experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to make SEO decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Willingness to take ownership, solve problems, and continuously improve processes.

Application Process

To apply, please submit:

  • Your resume showing your hands-on SEO experience, particularly work involving technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimization, reporting, and measurable results across client accounts.
  • A cover letter explaining your SEO experience and approach. Please include examples of SEO campaigns or client accounts you've worked on and the results you were able to achieve.
  • A test Gorilla assessment is required as part of the application process. It will be used to evaluate your practical SEO knowledge and problem solving ability. Please make sure you are ready to complete the assessment in one sitting and have a quiet environment with a stable internet connection before beginning.

Benefits

  • Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you.
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

---

  • As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page).

    • Record your answers in a quiet, well-lit, and clutter-free space with a stable internet connection.
  • We’re excited to get to know you better! Show us your personality and strengths. We encourage you to answer authentically and in your own words, without reading from a script or using AI tools.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Lead Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React)

Mexico City, Mexico – Remote. -- Please note thatwhile this role is remote, we require team members to be based in this region for periodic in-person meet-ups.

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join our team, taking technical ownership of a high-impact, customer-facing product, which some of the world's biggest companies, central banks and non-governmental organisations use to build revenue and volume through data and analytics. This is an opportunity to influence technical direction, elevate engineering standards and deliver features that make a meaningful difference to our clients.

What success looks like in this role:

  • Taking responsibility for the quality of the code and architecture delivered by your team

  • Influencing and coaching the team engineers

You should apply if you can confidently:

  • Communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical people

Tech Stack:

At FXC Intelligence, we are enthusiastic about the use of AI tools and value candidates with experience or interest in AI technologies. If AI assistance is used in tasks or interviews where it was not permitted and is detected, the submission may be discounted.

About us:

FXC Intelligence is a leading provider of cross-border payments data and intelligence, providing some of the world's biggest companies, central banks and non-governmental organisations with the strategic insights, expertise and awareness to effectively compete in their chosen markets. By joining us, you will be diving into a world of data-driven exploration and innovation, revolutionising financial insights through cutting-edge technologies, machine learning and predictive analytics.

Your contributions will shape the future of cross-border finance, helping clients to uncover better paths to growth and profitability, as well as being a trusted reference and source for many of the leading international publications.

We are proud to produce industry-changing data and intelligence, aided by our company values of being customer-focused, taking ownership, knowledge, communication and leadership.

We’re an innovative company that strives to look after its team, and we take pride in providing a positive company culture. Feel free to check out ourBlog,Instagram, andGlassdoorpages to learn more about our culture and hear directly from our team about what it's really like to work with us!

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

The Team


Channel9 was built to turn the heads of our Core sellers, make them fall in love with Cortex and help companies transform their security operations. Through short, engaging, relevant, funny & “edutaining” content, we grew to 7.7K internal followers (one-third of the company), including 60% of our sellers, 3.5K resellers and a large public/customer audience that we don’t even fully measure. Recently, we’ve been tapping into physical experiences like the Cortex Escape Room @ HQ to make our customer engagement more exciting, more experiential. And we’re just getting started.


At Channel9, work feels like playing in a band, and our audience sees this come across our content. Our philosophy is simple: take complicated things and turn them into bite-sized, highly engaging content that people actually want to watch. Clear up misunderstandings. Make the light bulb turn on. Create excitement. Help someone become better at their job. Sellers’ self-reported Channel9 revenue influence ended up over $19M in FY26, and this is a conservative number - so we’re onto something.


We are seeking a highly creative and engaging Channel9 Content Creator & Evangelist to conceptualize and produce compelling cybersecurity content for our audience. In this remote role, you will act as the trusted voice of Channel9, translating complex technical concepts into clear, memorable, and entertaining stories. You will build strong relationships across engineering, product, and sales teams to uncover unique narratives and deliver them through various formats including short-form video, podcasts, and live events. This is a unique opportunity to grow your personal brand while empowering our partner and customer community to learn and succeed.


Key Responsibilities


  • Conceptualize and produce engaging content across formats like short-form video, podcasts, and interviews.
  • Translate complex cybersecurity technology and sales concepts into clear, memorable, and fun narratives.
  • Build relationships across engineering, product, sales, and customers to uncover compelling stories.
  • Develop a unique, trusted voice and point of view for the Channel9 audience.
  • Serve as the recognizable face of Channel9, speaking at conferences, customer events, and internal EBCs.
  • Drive audience growth and engagement by continuously experimenting with new content formats.
  • Empower the audience with technical and sales knowledge to boost confidence and curiosity.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in content creation, technical evangelism, sales engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex technical or cybersecurity concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated on-camera presence and excellent public speaking skills.
  • Exceptional storytelling, interviewing, and communication abilities.
  • High degree of self-motivation, independence, and ability to manage your own content calendar.
  • Strong relationship-building skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry.
  • Existing portfolio of published content, such as podcasts, videos, or technical blogs.
  • Experience speaking at large-scale industry conferences or customer events.
  • Familiarity with video and audio editing tools and production workflows.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$163,200.00 - $264,000.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Medical Director, Hematology – Lymphoma leads the medical strategy for the Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma (CTCL) disease area within Hematology Medical Affairs, driving both brand medical strategy and external engagement with Opinion Leaders, community physicians, medical societies, and top accounts.

This role offers an experienced Medical Director the opportunity to lead medical strategy for a complex hematologic malignancy, engaging across the hematology-oncology, dermatology, and dermato-oncology communities while shaping how Sobi supports the CTCL patient and provider community. The Senior Medical Director will also lead launch preparatory efforts for lacutamab, a humanized monoclonal antibody immunotherapy targeting KIR3DL2.

The Senior Medical Director serves as the lead medical voice for lymphoma and lacutamab, conceptualizing and implementing the US medical strategy for the disease area. This person reports to the Vice President, Head of Hematology Medical Affairs, partners closely with Field Medical to engage HCPs, medical organizations, payers, and patient advocacy groups, and acts as the medical lead on the Brand Team.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Strategy & Launch Leadership

  • Serve as the lead medical strategist for CTCL and lacutamab, providing strategic leadership for medical strategy, brand-aligned tactics, and external clinician engagement across academic, community, and multidisciplinary care settings
  • Own launch readiness for lacutamab, including disease education, unmet need articulation, and evidence generation planning
  • Contribute analytic expertise and insights to Medical Affairs deliverables

External Engagement & Field Medical Partnership

  • Partner with Field Medical to develop and enhance KOL and key institution engagement plans, positioning Sobi as the scientific partner of choice for CTCL across the hematology-oncology community
  • Collaborate with Field Medical on resource needs and development of field materials and tactics specific to CTCL and lacutamab
  • Lead planning and execution of advisory boards and educational activities (webinars, medical roundtables, symposia, congress presence)

Insight Generation & Evidence

  • Generate and share medical insights with the field team; analyze insights to inform strategy and tactical adjustments
  • Contribute to evidence generation projects, real-world evidence studies, and publications supporting the CTCL disease area and lacutamab

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong collaborative relationships with Market Access, Medical Information, Clinical Development, Sales, and Marketing
  • Act as the medical lead on the Brand Team and support cross-functional initiatives across the organization

Culture

  • Contribute to a strong team culture within Hematology/Oncology Medical Affairs, grounded in mutual respect and constructive challenge toward shared goals

Required

  • MD, PhD, or PharmD
  • 5+ years of Medical Director experience
  • Pre-launch and/or launch experience
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex scientific concepts for varied audiences
  • Strong ability to form meaningful, bi-directional relationships with the medical community
  • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, with strategic and analytical capability
  • Demonstrated leadership across core Medical Affairs functions (evidence generation, publications, medical education, strategy development)
  • Willingness and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, team-based environment with colleagues at all levels
  • Self-starter with strong interpersonal skills and a results-driven, solution-oriented approach
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, primarily domestic
  • Patient-focused mindset

Preferred

  • Background in Hematology-Oncology

Competencies & Attributes

  • Strong scientific curiosity with the drive to lead in a complex, evolving disease space
  • Adept, nimble, and energetic in a fast-paced, dynamic, collaborative environment
  • Hands-on, "roll up one's sleeves" approach
  • Drive for results with urgency and innovation
  • Comfortable operating within a "one team, common purpose" culture

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

  • A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
  • Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
  • A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
  • Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $250,000 – $320,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access this website to apply for a vacancy as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to .

Know Your Rights

At Sobi, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion creates stronger teams. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective and experiences could be exactly what we need. We look forward to hearing from you!

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of people who live with a rare disease. Our edge comes from our team of people and our commitment to patients.

Our mission and culture at Sobi North America get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

  • Opportunity to broaden your horizons by attending popular conferences

raw.description:
About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded textured haircare brand built on a scalp-first philosophy, authentic results, and a deeply engaged community. We serve customers across our website, app, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, and emerging channels. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Senior CRM Manager to own the execution and performance of our customer relationship marketing program. You will lead email and SMS campaigns, build and improve automated journeys, and turn customer insight into stronger repeat purchase, subscription retention, and long-term value. Q4 execution is an immediate priority, alongside building a durable lifecycle program.

This is a working manager role. You will set priorities, work directly in Klaviyo, review every major send for accuracy, analyze performance, and coach our CRM Coordinator. You will partner with the future Director of Retention & Customer Lifecycle, who will own the broader retention strategy, budget, and department roadmap.

What You Will Own

Campaign Strategy and Q4 Execution

  • Own the email and SMS calendar for launches, education, promotions, replenishment, and engagement.
  • Translate business priorities into briefs, audience plans, creative requirements, send schedules, and measurable goals.
  • Lead Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday CRM planning, including offers, segmentation, contact frequency, contingency plans, and recaps.
  • Partner with Brand, Creative, E-Commerce, Growth, Product, and CX to deliver timely, accurate messages.
  • Establish pre-send QA for audience, consent, suppression, offer, inventory, links, rendering, timing, and tracking.

Lifecycle and Retention

  • Audit, build, and optimize welcome, browse and cart abandonment, post-purchase, education, replenishment, cross-sell, winback, and subscription journeys.
  • Segment first-time, repeat, high-value, lapsed, and subscription customers using purchase behavior, product interest, and engagement.
  • Improve second purchase, frequency, subscription save and renewal, and customer lifetime value.
  • Collaborate with Subscription, CX, and E-Commerce on friction that requires changes beyond messaging.
  • Coordinate email, SMS, and relevant app messaging so the customer experience remains coherent.

Klaviyo, Data, and Operations

  • Serve as a hands-on Klaviyo owner for campaigns, flows, segments, templates, testing, and reporting.
  • Help complete and stabilize the email and SMS migration to Klaviyo. Validate customer data, consent and suppressions, event tracking, flows, integrations, and deliverability before and after cutover.
  • Partner with E-Commerce and technical resources on Shopify, subscription, and other customer events.
  • Create documentation, naming conventions, approval workflows, and repeatable QA checklists.
  • Protect list health, deliverability, and customer preferences while operating an ambitious calendar.

Measurement and Leadership

  • Own weekly CRM reporting across campaign and flow results, customer cohorts, repeat purchase, subscription behavior, list health, and testing insights.
  • Build a prioritized test plan for audiences, content, timing, offers, and journeys. Use baselines and holdouts where feasible to assess incremental impact.
  • Manage, coach, and set priorities for the CRM Coordinator. Review work and build technical and analytical skills.
  • Manage agency or freelance support when needed and flag capacity, data, creative, or launch risks early.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Assess current performance and the Klaviyo migration, stabilize the Q4 calendar and QA process, identify urgent flow and deliverability gaps, and establish a weekly scorecard.
  • First 60 days: Own campaign execution, improve priority flows and segments, implement a test roadmap, and give the coordinator clear ownership and coaching.
  • First 90 days: Deliver a dependable CRM operating rhythm, documented lifecycle priorities, measurable improvements in customer behavior, and a clear optimization plan.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in CRM, lifecycle, retention, or email and SMS marketing, with substantial consumer e-commerce experience.
  • Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience building and troubleshooting flows, segments, campaigns, and reporting.
  • Experience leading a high-volume promotional calendar while protecting deliverability and customer experience.
  • Strong grasp of segmentation, testing, purchase cohorts, retention economics, and lifecycle measurement.
  • Experience with Shopify and comfort diagnosing customer data and event quality.
  • Strong project management, copy and creative judgment, attention to detail, and comfort making decisions under tight deadlines.
  • Experience managing or coaching a coordinator or small team.
  • Subscription, beauty or personal care, mobile app, and multichannel experience are pluses.

Who You Are

You combine commercial judgment with careful execution. You can build a flow yourself, challenge an unconvincing metric, give clear feedback, and catch a broken offer before it reaches customers. You take ownership of results and develop the people around you.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Bask & Lather Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

Salary: $110,000-$130,000

We are seeking an energetic, outgoing, and exceptionally personable Bilingual Virtual Front Desk & Insurance Specialist to serve as the vital front-line ambassador for a fast-growing U.S.-based mental health practice. Combining high-volume inbound/outbound phone management, patient scheduling, and light insurance verification support, this is a highly patient-facing, high-touch role.

We are specifically seeking a candidate with an upbeat, warm, confident, and engaging phone demeanor in both English and Spanish. Rather than a passive assistant, the practice requires a self-directed problem-solver who takes complete ownership of patient inquiries, manages heavy call volumes with ease, and provides an compassionate, outstanding experience for individuals seeking mental health and TMS therapy services.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Bilingual Front Desk & Insurance Verifications/Auths Specialist
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (US Eastern Standard Time)
  • Language Requirement: Fully Bilingual (Fluent English & Spanish - Non-Negotiable)
  • Practice Specialty: Psychiatry, Mental Health & TMS Therapy

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  • High-Volume Front Office Communication: Handle high-volume inbound and outbound patient calls (50–150 calls per day) using Weave, delivering exceptional customer care, answering treatment inquiries, and scheduling appointments.
  • Patient Scheduling & Intake Management: Manage provider calendars, guide prospective mental health and TMS therapy patients through the intake process, and assist with general administrative requests.
  • Insurance Verifications & Authorizations (Support): Provide occasional, targeted support with verifying insurance eligibility, checking benefit coverage, and navigating payer portals as needed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Inbound & Outbound Phone Operations: Serve as the primary voice of the practice using Weave, answering patient calls, conducting follow-up outreach, and managing appointment confirmations, cancellations, and reschedules in English and Spanish.
  • Patient Inquiry & Care Coordination: Warmly address non-clinical questions regarding psychiatry, TMS therapy, and mental health services, guiding patients smoothly into the practice's care pipeline.
  • Administrative Front Desk Support: Maintain accurate patient records, organize digital intake workflows, update patient charts, and manage daily calendar tasks using Google Workspace tools and GoHighLevel.
  • Insurance & Auth Support: Perform secondary insurance eligibility checks, verify coverage details on payer platforms, and assist with prior authorization documentation when necessary.
  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Identify administrative bottlenecks, manage high call density with composure, and maintain high patient satisfaction across every interaction.

Requirements

  • Bilingual Fluency: Fluent, natural spoken and written English and Spanish.
  • U.S. Practice Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct experience supporting a U.S.-based medical practice in a front-office, administrative, or patient-coordination capacity.
  • Engaging Phone Demeanor: A bubbly, upbeat, warm, and highly confident phone presence—capable of building instant rapport without sounding scripted, timid, or robotic.
  • Phone & Scheduling Proficiency: Proven background handling inbound/outbound calls, patient scheduling, and customer service.
  • Lead & Growth Mindset: Comfort making outbound calls to prospective patients, addressing barriers to care, and guiding leads toward booking appointments.
  • Problem-Solving Ability: Proven track record of working independently, following through on tasks without constant direction, and bringing solutions to operational challenges.
  • HIPAA Compliance & Setup: Strong understanding of HIPAA guidelines and a quiet, private, HIPAA-compliant home workspace equipped with a high-speed computer setup and a clear noise-canceling headset.

Strongly Preferred

  • Lead Conversion & Sales: Background in patient acquisition, medical sales, or lead conversion.
  • Specialty Practice Models: Direct experience in Direct Primary Care (DPC), Concierge Medicine, Medical Spa, Wellness, or Cash-Pay practice environments.
  • Membership Billing: Hands-on experience with recurring membership billing models and membership CRM/lead management platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a vibrant, articulate, and resourceful bilingual coordinator who loves connecting with people over the phone. You treat every patient and prospective lead like a VIP, take immense pride in keeping clinic workflows organized, and take full ownership of helping a medical practice grow.

raw.excerpt: Lessen is the tech-enabled, end-to-end property service provider that is transforming how commercial and residential real estate services are delivered and managed at scale.
raw.description:
Lessen is the tech-enabled, end-to-end property service provider that is transforming how commercial and residential real estate services are delivered and managed at scale. Lessen’s technology platform provides data-driven insights that unlock key growth opportunities for the entire real estate ecosystem—including investors, owners, managers, and service providers. The company leverages a network of over 30,000 vetted, qualified vendors (Lessen Affiliates) serving clients with over 1 million properties and completing more than 3.5 million work orders annually across an expanding range of services. Lessen, LLC is a venture-backed, privately held company with offices in Scottsdale and Chicago.
The Trade Specialist plays an integral role in customer and vendor support to a specific client base. This role is responsible for implementing and maintaining client and associate relationships, while serving as a specific trade related SME for complex issues and queries, proactively resolving their daily challenges.
This role will require weekend and/or evening availability.
This is a remote position that must live in the United States, and solid HVAC knowledge is required.

What You'll Do:

    • Build and maintain professional relationships with clients and vendors to gain an understanding of their operational needs in a specific trade related area, assists in the development and implementation of solutions to meet those needs

    • Review vendor quotes on behalf of client to ensure scope and pricing of suggested work is appropriate

    • Develop and coordinate client and internal initiatives and special projects

    • Serve as a technical and subject matter expert resource for the department and leadership

    • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external clients; resolving issues with vendors as necessary

    • Proactively resolve vendor and client issues; drive all issues towards resolution and escalates on a timely basis only when necessary

    • Provide support to Trade Representative as required

    • Foster a positive work environment and collaborate effectively with all stakeholders

    • Ensure confidentiality of internal and external data

    • Perform ad-hoc projects and other duties as assigned

    • Maintain CPD and awareness of trade / industry developments

    • Seek opportunities for continuous process improvement

You Should Have:

    Professional Skills

    • Customer Service Skills - Proficient

    • Verbal Communication Skills - Proficient

    • Written Communication Skills - Proficient

    • Teamwork Skills - Proficient

    • Relationship Skills - Proficient

    • Negotiation Skills – Proficient

    • Problem-Solving Skills - Advanced

    • Prioritization Skills - Proficient

    Role Specific Skills

    • Computer Skills: Intermediate proficiencies in: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook preferred

    • SME in a specific relevant trade

    • HVAC field experience preferred

    Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

    • Relevant trade qualification

    • 3 – 4 years of experience in relevant field or internal promotion from within Lessen

    • Experience working in an FM, retail, buildings environment

    • Demonstrable experience of solving complex trade related technical issues

Why Lessen:
· Competitive compensation
· Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability options
· 401K retirement savings plan
· Paid vacation, federal and floating holidays
· Maternity/Paternity Pay
· Career advancement opportunities
· All the tools you'll need to be successful
Lessen is intentional about attracting, developing, and retaining amazing talent from diverse backgrounds. We’re looking for teammates that are enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and will help us amplify the positive & inclusive culture we’ve been building. Lessen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

raw.title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
raw.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in South Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in South Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
