raw.title: Engineering Manager - Energy
raw.excerpt: We work together.  Your team and the people you will work with… Energy is at the heart of UW, with over 95% of our customers taking at least one Energy service.
raw.description:
We work together. Your team and the people you will work with…

Energy is at the heart of UW, with over 95% of our customers taking at least one Energy service.

We work in small, fully autonomous teams with real ownership of their products.

You will join the Technology & Product function, specifically within the Engineering family. You will co-lead a squad alongside a Product Manager, working in a cross-functional environment with colleagues in UX and Data. Your role is to create clarity, consistency, and momentum within your squad while raising the team's voice to senior leadership. You'll act as a bridge, interacting with stakeholders across the business to provide vital insight and context to your team.

We deliver progress. What you’ll do and how you will make an impact.

As an Engineering Manager at UW you create clarity, consistency, and momentum in your squad. You set direction, ensure high standards in both delivery and quality, and balance short-term goals with long-term sustainability. You invest in people through coaching, feedback, and development, while fostering a positive team culture. You communicate effectively across levels, manage complexity, and continuously grow as a leader in order to enable your teams to do their best work. You will have the following responsibilities:

  • Technical Mastery: Take responsibility for the technical decisions the squad makes and ensure they align with company and technical strategy. You have a clear understanding of the engineering practices within the team and identify opportunities for improvement. You understand all of the technologies used by UW in your squad, and how they fit together.

  • Impact: Take an integral role in defining team goals and ensuring proposed work is aligned with them. You drive prioritisation within the team to best achieve goals. You push yourself and the team to achieve team goals.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify and put in place practices needed to ensure security and operational service level objectives (SLOs) are met. You coordinate with your squad — and others as needed — to ensure organisation-wide on-call coverage. You drive the squad to operational excellence, leading regular metrics reviews to ensure high coverage and performance.

  • Planning & Delivery: Work with the Product Manager and team to set objectives and key results (OKRs) that align with company goals. You identify risks and blockers early and work with stakeholders to mitigate them. You measure team performance so that you can continually improve it. You communicate team progress against OKRs, key performance indicators (KPIs) and other milestones to relevant stakeholders. You co-lead annual and quarterly planning for your squad.

  • People & Coaching: You ensure the squad is staffed with the technical skillsets to deliver objectives, developing skills within team members and/or hiring as needed. You onboard, train, develop and coach your reports to facilitate their career growth. You participate in performance calibration and promotion reviews for your squad.

  • Business & Domain knowledge: Understand and communicate company, department, and pillar strategy and goals to your squad. You interact with stakeholders from across the business in order to provide insight and context to their teams.

  • Leadership & Culture: Teach our culture to others and foster a healthy dynamic within your team. You help to resolve interpersonal conflicts and gather, share and act on feedback. You effectively communicate company and department changes to your squad. With help from your manager, you raise the team's voice to senior leadership. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional colleagues, such as UX and data. You co-lead your squad with your squad's Product Manager. You ensure team expenditures (both OpEx and CapEx) are in line with budgets.

We put people first. It’s all about you…

Technical Mastery:

  • Knowledge (experience is a bonus) of our core tech stack; gRPC, GraphQL, React, Kafka, Docker & Kubernetes, experience with Go is preferred but not essential.
  • Experience leading the team's technical design process, facilitating design discussions and representing the team in cross-functional technical conversations.
  • Ability to drive technical decisions to clear, well-documented outcomes by evaluating options, trade-offs, and next steps when the team disagrees.
  • Experience validating designs and architecture against real-world edge cases and domain variations to minimise avoidable rework.
  • Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, ensuring they align with product and engineering strategy.
  • Strong understanding of engineering best practices, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Hands-on experience with AI development tools; we value engineers who embrace AI in their day-to-day work and see AI-assisted software development as part of the future of engineering

Impact:

  • Experience defining team goals and driving prioritisation to achieve them.
  • Experience creating clarity when competing priorities, technical options, or complex legacy system migrations threaten focus or timelines.

Planning & Delivery:

  • Ability to work with Product Managers to set OKRs aligned with company goals. Ability to co-lead annual and quarterly planning.
  • Experience identifying risks early and mitigating them.
  • Experience improving delivery predictability by surfacing risks early and cutting or sequencing scope to protect commitments.

Operational Excellence:

  • Experience identifying practices for security and SLOs.
  • Ability to drive operational excellence and lead metrics reviews.

People & Coaching:

  • Experience of managing a team of engineers.
  • Proven ability to onboard, train, develop, and coach reports, as well as. participating in performance calibration and promotion reviews.

Business & Domain Knowledge:

  • Intermediate awareness of customer and market insights.
  • Ability to communicate strategy to the squad.
  • Experience building deep domain knowledge of the squad’s area, beyond the happy path, including the variations that show up in real customer, partner, and operational scenarios.
  • Ability to push back early when requirements or designs are ambiguous or incomplete, so issues are caught before build.
  • Experience working within complex, multi-variant domains (such as billing, pricing, identity, or claims) where handling intricate logical edge cases is critical.

Leadership & Culture:

  • Experience fostering a healthy team dynamic and resolving interpersonal conflicts.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional colleagues.

So why pick UW?

We’ve got big ambitions so there’s going to be plenty of challenges. There are also a lot of benefits:

  • Competitive salary: We benchmark against the industry and will share the salary openly during our first conversation.
  • Performance bonus: An annual discretionary bonus ranging from 15-40%.
  • Flexible working: We’re a remote-first business. More details can be found here.
  • Work-life balance: We offer an optional four-day working week (90% pay for 90% impact).
  • Work from anywhere: You can work abroad for up to three weeks, twice every tax year.
  • Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays (increasing with tenure), with the option to trade up to five days each year.
  • UW discounts: Save on our services and get a free Cashback Card.
  • Future planning: Matched-contribution pension scheme and life assurance (up to 4x salary).
  • Family first: Policies designed to help you and your family thrive.
  • Flexible benefits: An allowance for private health insurance, dental insurance, or gym membership.
  • Sabbaticals: An eight-week paid sabbatical after four years of service.
  • Growth: A dedicated learning and development budget and bi-annual promotion cycles.
  • Inclusion: Join belonging groups that help shape our culture.
  • Events: Company-wide celebrations including the ‘Great Big Get Together’ and our ‘Good Hearted Go-Getter Awards’.

Apply now

You’ve made it this far... hit apply! We can’t wait to hear from you.

Worried you don’t hit every single bit of the criteria? We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you’re a go-getter with a great heart, get your application in and let’s chat.

Not sure you meet all the requirements? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs if they think they may not meet every qualification, when in fact they often do.

We provide equal opportunities, a diverse and inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. You are welcome to apply no matter your age, disability, gender, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity status, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. Please don’t be afraid to ask about what we can do to support your needs. All requests will be carefully and fairly considered.

Please note, if you are successful and offered a role at UW, you will be subject to a background check. Where checks are unsatisfactory or incomplete and/or a failure to reveal information relating to convictions that you are required to identify as part of the background checks, could lead to withdrawal of an offer of employment.

Hi! We're UW. We’re on a mission to take the headache out of utilities by providing them all in one place. One bill for energy, broadband, mobile and insurance and a whole lot of savings!

We’re aiming to double in size as we help more people to stop wasting time and money—big ambitions, to be delivered by people like you.

Got your attention? Read on…

raw.description:
À propos de Dialogue

Dialogue est le principal fournisseur de soins virtuels au Canada. En perfectionnant notre Plateforme de santé intégrée, nous offrons des programmes exceptionnels de santé et de bien-être en ligne (soins primaires, santé mentale, TCCi, PAE et bien-être) aux organisations qui souhaitent améliorer le bien-être de leurs employé(e)s et de leurs familles.

Lorsqu'il s'agit de notre travail, nous plaçons la barre très haut. Ensemble, nous transformons la santé et aidons des millions de personnes à améliorer leur bien-être. Nous croyons fermement qu’une équipe exceptionnelle exige plus pour sa :

  • Réussite
  • Communauté
  • Croissance
  • Performance

Vous avez l’impression de pouvoir changer les choses? Bonne nouvelle, nous avons une place pour vous!

Nous vous acceptons comme vous êtes. En tant qu’employeur soucieux de l’égalité des chances, Dialogue s’engage à créer un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour tout le monde. Les personnes qualifiées qui poseront leur candidature seront considérées sans égard à la citoyenneté, l’origine ethnique, la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression sexuelle, l’orientation sexuelle, le handicap, l’âge ou le statut de vétéran. Les personnes qui ont besoin d’accommodations spéciaux sont invitées à nous écrire à l’adresse

Déclaration sur l'utilisation de l'IA

Afin d'assurer un processus d'examen efficace et équitable, nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour aider au tri et à l'évaluation initiale des candidatures pour ce poste.

⚠️ Avis de fraude en recrutement

Dialogue communique avec les candidat(e)s uniquement par des adresses courriel officielles @dialogue.co. Nous ne demandons jamais de paiement, de cartes-cadeaux ni de renseignements financiers personnels à quelque étape que ce soit du processus d'embauche, et nous n'envoyons jamais d'offre d'emploi sans un processus d'entrevue structuré. Tous nos postes sont affichés exclusivement sur dialogue.co/fr/carrieres. Si vous recevez une communication suspecte prétendant provenir de Dialogue, ne répondez pas — signalez-la à et vérifiez le poste sur notre page carrières officielle.

Votre rôle à titre de Psychothérapeute

Dialogue est à la recherche d'un Psychothérapeute ou d'une Psychothérapeute pour prendre part à notre mission d'aider les gens à améliorer leur bien-être. Sous la supervision d'Etienne Bolze, gestionnaire, Thérapeutes en santé mentale et Psychothérapeutes, votre rôle consistera à donner à nos patients les moyens de parler ouvertement de leur santé mentale et à créer un environnement sans jugement.

Nos Psychothérapeutes sont des professionnel(le)s de la santé mentale agréé(e)s et formé(e)s. Ils ou Elles détiennent une Maîtrise dans un domaine lié à la santé mentale et sont membres d’un ordre professionnel et/ou d’un collège.

En tant que Psychothérapeute agréé(e), vous fournirez un soutien clinique axé sur les objectifs et adapté pour atteindre des résultats mesurables dans un cadre à court terme.

Vos responsabilités

  • Mener des séances virtuelles pour les membres présentant des symptômes de santé mentale.
  • Assurer un suivi auprès des clients pour garantir les progrès dans leur parcours de soins avec Dialogue.
  • Fournir des soins fondés sur des données probantes dans un environnement collaboratif, en priorisant la stabilisation émotionnelle, la sécurité et le développement de la résilience psychologique.
  • Fournir aux membres des stratégies d'adaptation pratiques et des outils basés sur la TCC pour gérer efficacement les facteurs de stress aigus et améliorer le fonctionnement quotidien.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec nos gestionnaires de cas internes et nos équipes cliniques pour garantir un système de soutien holistique et harmonieux pour chaque client.
  • Maintenir une vigilance constante en matière de sécurité des membres dans toutes les interactions cliniques, en veillant à ce que les normes éthiques et les protocoles de crise soient strictement respectés.
  • Contribuer activement à l'évolution de nos normes de soins, en veillant à ce que chaque intervention réponde aux plus hautes références d'excellence clinique.
  • Vous serez responsable de la sécurité des patients dans votre rôle de contact avec les membres

Nous aimerions beaucoup vous rencontrer si vous possédez

  • Une Maîtrise dans un domaine lié à la santé mentale (p. ex. : psychologie du counseling, travail social ou une discipline connexe).
  • Maintenez un permis valide et actif pour exercer la psychothérapie dans la province de Québec, de l'Ontario (p. ex. : OPQ, OTSTCFQ, CRPO), ou autre province canadienne.
  • Possédez une assurance responsabilité professionnelle appropriée et à jour.
  • Démontrez 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en tant que Psychothérapeute agréé(e).
  • Démontrez une affinité pour la thérapie à court terme et axée sur les objectifs, avec un engagement constant envers une approche centrée sur le patient.
  • Une expérience antérieure, ou une grande aisance, dans la prestation de soins de haute qualité via des plateformes de télémédecine.
  • La capacité de travailler un minimum de 8 heures (jusqu'à 32 heures) par semaine, y compris une rotation flexible de jours, de soirs et de fins de semaine.
  • Une aisance avec les outils informatiques modernes et un désir de travailler dans un environnement de technologie de la santé innovant et au rythme rapide.
  • Un(e) professionnel(le) autonome et motivé(e) qui valorise l'autonomie, l'excellence clinique et l'opportunité de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé mentale accessibles.

Chez Dialogue, votre bien-être est notre priorité.

Prendre soin des autres, c’est aussi prendre soin de notre équipe! Selon votre rôle et votre statutd’emploi, vous pourriez avoir accès aux avantages suivants :

  • Accès à l’application Dialogue et au soutien virtuel en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille
  • Assurance entièrement couverte, compte de dépenses pour la santé, couverture dentaire et remboursement de bien-être
  • 4 semaines de vacances, 9 journées de bien-être et 1 journée de bénévolat
  • Programmes d'incitation, primes de référencement et cotisation équivalente au REER
  • Apprentissage via Coursera, budget de formation externe et programme de mentorat
  • Prestation facultative pour le congé parental

raw.description:
Senior Project Manger

New Meridian Corporation, located in Austin, TX seeks outstanding candidates for the role of Senior Project Manager. This position, reporting to the Director of Program Management, will assume overall responsibility for providing project management support to deliver contractual obligations for key strategic internal projects at New Meridian.

WHO WE ARE:

New Meridian is a non-profit, assessment design and development organization. We believe assessments should focus on skills that matter: critical thinking, deep understanding, and the ability to communicate ideas effectively, helping prepare students to adapt and thrive in a complex world. At New Meridian, we create high-quality assessments that measure these skills to ensure all students have access to valuable educational experiences.

Our mission is to advance the quality of public education for all students by designing assessments that focus on the skills that matter.

Our team is defined by a strong commitment to improving student learning, empowering teachers, and advancing the role of high-quality assessment in expanding opportunity for all students. We are recognized leaders in assessment innovation, driven by our willingness to tackle complex challenges and our dedication to delivering exceptional support to our partners.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

SUMMARY: We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Project Managerto oversee certain aspects of complex projects in the K–12 education assessment space. In this role, you will be accountable for leading end-to-end project delivery—from planning through execution—ensuring all milestones are achieved on time, within scope, and at the highest quality. You will collaborate closely with state education agencies, vendors, and internal teams to align goals, manage expectations, and navigate the intricacies of large-scale assessment programs. This role requires a deep knowledge of the assessment process, strong leadership and communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

An ideal candidate:

  • Shares a strong commitment to our mission of advancing equity in educational opportunities for all students and understands the role that large-scale assessments can play in achieving that goal.
  • Can drive project execution, ensure timely delivery of high-quality products and services, and maintain strong relationships with state education clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Brings a deep understanding of the assessment lifecycle, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Is results-driven, resourceful, action oriented, and persistent. You are an expert organizer and project planner who consistently looks ahead and anticipates needs before they arise.
  • Can quickly adapt and develop creative solutions to assessment and content development challenges.
  • Must be highly self-aware and perceptive to the dynamics of key relationships, naturally gaining the respect of colleagues, vendors, and clients through authenticity, warmth, and competence.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to contribute to a positive organizational culture – one of generosity, trustworthiness, and curiosity.

EXPECTED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee project timelines and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure milestones and deliverables are met on time and to the highest quality standards.
  • Lead the planning, development, and implementation of processes, schedules, and deliverables for education assessment programs, ensuring alignment with client expectations and contractual requirements.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive risk management plans to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks.
  • Design and manage communication strategies to keep internal teams and external stakeholders informed and aligned throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Program Management to prepare for key meetings, including developing agendas, capturing action items, and ensuring timely follow-up.
  • Ensure adherence to secure delivery protocols and compliance standards related to online assessment systems.

REQUIREMENTS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years’ experience in managing education related projects is required.
  • Proven experience working on large-scale assessment programs for state or district-level clients is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with secure, online delivery platforms and familiarity with data privacy standards in K–12 education is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft Project, Excel, and the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills in deadline-driven environments.
  • Strong interpersonal and client-facing communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across multiple stakeholders.
  • PMP certification strongly preferred.
  • Remote position with occasional travel for client meetings or onsite events.

SALARY AND BENEFITS:

We offer a competitive annual salary. Our benefits package includes:

  • Medical, prescription, and behavioral health coverages.
  • Dental coverage.
  • Vision coverage.
  • Life and AD&D coverage.
  • Short-and long-term disability.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Up to 20 days of PTO per year.
  • 17 paid holidays.
  • Accrued Sick Leave
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Remote work and flexible schedules.

New Meridian Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and identities to apply. We are excited to receive applications from people in occupations or positions where they are under-represented, particularly from individuals connected to underserved communities. We feel we are strengthened by diverse perspectives.

Technical Customer Success Manager

Technical - Civil Engineering

Location: Remote within Canada (Occasional Travel Required)

About us

At Niricson, we’re transforming the way aging infrastructure is inspected and managed — helping asset owners make smarter, safer, and more sustainable decisions. Our proprietary technologies combine robotics, AI, and data analytics to deliver unparalleled insights into the health of civil structures like dams, bridges, and airfields. As we scale, our Sales and Technical teams are working hand in hand to deliver world-class service to our clients in the hydro, transportation, and energy sectors.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Technical Customer Service Manager to serve as the essential bridge between our clients and technical teams. You’ll step in once contracts are signed, managing client communication, keeping projects on track, and ensuring our clients feel informed and confident in every stage of delivery — from production to results handoff and beyond.

This is a unique role that blends technical understanding with excellent client service. If you have a background in civil engineering or physics, experience with technical projects, and a passion for delivering top-tier customer experiences, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients during project delivery, from contract signing to post-project support

raw.title: Director, New Business Sales
raw.excerpt: About PortlessPortless is a tech-enabled supply chain business that helps DTC brands ship directly from Asia to customers worldwide in 5-9 days.
raw.description:
About Portless

Portless is a tech-enabled supply chain business that helps DTC brands ship directly from Asia to customers worldwide in 5-9 days. We're transforming how ecommerce brands think about fulfillment by eliminating the traditional 60-90 day ocean freight model and replacing it with faster, more flexible, cash-flow friendly logistics.

We're venture backed and growing fast. Our customers include brands shipping everything from apparel to consumer electronics, and we operate in 55+ countries. We're on a mission to make global fulfillment as seamless as domestic shipping.

The Role

We're looking for a Director of New Business Sales to lead the team of AEs responsible for winning new logos at Portless.

You'll inherit a team of seven new business Account Executives selling into the SMB and Mid-Market segments, with ACVs most commonly associated with Enterprise deal values in other industries. These are real deals with real complexity: multiple stakeholders, operational diligence, and buyers who need to move physical product in order to go live with our solution. Your team owns those deals end-to-end, from qualified opportunity through implementation.

This is a leadership role, not a player-coach role. You won't carry a personal quota. You will be measured on whether your team hits its number, and on whether the people on it get better while they do it. That means recruiting and retaining talent others want to hire, building a high-performance and low-ego culture, coaching at a world-class level, and knowing when to put your own hands on a deal.

It's also a global role. Our fulfillment operations run out of Asia, and our customers are expanding into Europe, Australia, and the wider APAC region. You'll work directly with our teams on the ground in those markets and help your AEs run deal cycles across them. The time zones required to execute at a global scale demand flexibility beyond a traditional 9 to 5 and we're looking for someone who treats that as part of the opportunity rather than an inconvenience.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit and retain outstanding sales talent. You'll own hiring for the new business team as we scale beyond seven AEs, build a bench before you need it, and keep your best people here and growing.
  • Build a high-performance, low-ego culture where the team makes commitments, meets them, and holds each other to a standard which demands we all do the best work of our careers. You'll set the bar for what "on track" looks like and make missing it uncomfortable without making it personal.
  • Coach at a world-class level through call reviews, deal reviews, and 1:1s. You'll use our "One Thing" coaching philosophy to give each AE focused, specific feedback that measurably improves their craft.
  • Get into the deals that matter. You'll bring real deal sense to your team's highest-potential opportunities, joining calls, shaping strategy, engaging senior stakeholders, and helping close business without taking the deal away from the rep.
  • Own the number. You'll forecast accurately, track leading indicators, and diagnose pipeline problems early enough to do something about them.
  • Run deal cycles across regions. You'll partner directly with our team in Asia and support your AEs on opportunities in Europe, Australia, and APAC.
  • Develop the playbook for how new business is won at Portless, refining discovery, business case development, and competitive positioning as we scale.
  • Partner cross-functionally with BDRs on target account strategy and handoff quality, with Marketing on messaging, with Onboarding and Client Success on customer transitions, and with RevOps on the systems that make the team faster.
  • Maintain CRM discipline across the team, with accurate forecasting, clean deal stages, and activity logging in HubSpot.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 3+ years of sales leadership experience managing quota-carrying Account Executives.
  • Your own track record as a quota-bearing closer in the mid-market and/or enterprise space.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit great sales talent and retain it.
  • Demonstrated ability to build a team culture that consistently hits its commitments.
  • Demonstrated coaching ability, with specific examples of reps who measurably improved under you.
  • A track record of winning deals yourself, and of helping your team win deals you were involved in.
  • Comfort working across time zones, including direct collaboration with our team in Asia and deal cycles in Europe, Australia, and APAC.
  • Experience with CRM and sales tools (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, etc.).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience selling to ecommerce, DTC, or retail brands.
  • Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, 3PL, or fulfillment industry.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models.
  • Experience scaling a sales team through a period of rapid headcount growth.
  • Previous experience at a high-growth startup where you helped build the sales motion.

The intangibles we care about:

  • Coachable: You actively seek feedback and apply it fast.
  • Capable: Leadership is a craft to be mastered, you care about doing so.
  • Curious: When in doubt, figure it out. You are always looking to better understand your prospects, sales as a craft, and the ecommerce industry.
  • Resilient: You navigate complex deals and setbacks without losing momentum.
  • Driven: You're motivated by achievement and like to compete.
  • Low-Ego: If you aren't a team player you will fail here.

Why Portless

Ownership from day one: You'll have a team, a number, and autonomy to run your business.

Coaching culture: Our sales team operates on a "One Thing" coaching philosophy: focused, actionable feedback every week to help you improve.

Product that sells: DTC brands are under pressure to improve cash flow and expand globally. Our value prop is concrete and differentiated.

Growth trajectory: We're scaling fast. High performers will have opportunities to move into senior leadership or new market expansion.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Equity
  • Full benefits
  • Remote-first with occasional team onsites

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  1. Hiring manager interview with the VP of Sales (45 min)
  1. Case study take-home, reviewed with the broader Sales leadership team (45 min)
  1. Cross-functional interview with another member of the Portless leadership team (30 min)
  1. Offer

If you know how to turn email into a measurable growth and revenue channel, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Email Campaign Development & Execution

  • Build and launch email campaigns using platforms such as:

    • Marketo

  • Ensure campaigns are tested and error-free before launch

Email Automation & Nurture Workflows

    • Lead nurture sequences
    • Drip campaigns
    • Re-engagement campaigns
    • Abandoned cart flows
    • Lifecycle campaigns
  • Configure triggers, timing, conditions, and audience rules
  • Test automation workflows to ensure accurate execution
  • Continuously improve sequences based on engagement and conversion data

Audience Segmentation & List Management

  • Manage email databases ranging from 20K to 200K+ contacts
  • Segment audiences based on:
    • Persona
    • Lifecycle stage
    • Engagement
    • Geography
    • Customer behavior
  • Maintain clean and organized contact data
  • Remove or suppress bounced, inactive, and high-risk contacts
  • Protect overall list quality and sender reputation

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor email deliverability, inbox placement, and sender reputation
  • Support configuration and management of:
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DNS settings
    • Suppression lists
  • Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, and unsubscribe activity
  • Maintain compliance with applicable requirements including:
    • CAN-SPAM
    • GDPR
    • CCPA

Testing & Performance Optimization

  • Run structured A/B tests across:
    • Subject lines
    • Email copy
    • CTAs
    • Send times
    • Content variations
  • Track key performance metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Click-through rates (CTR)
    • Conversions
    • Unsubscribe rates
    • Bounce rates
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements
  • Use performance data to continuously improve engagement and conversion

Reporting & Revenue Attribution

  • Build weekly and monthly email performance reports
  • Track conversions and revenue attribution across ESP, CRM, and analytics platforms
  • Identify trends and opportunities within campaign data
  • Translate performance results into actionable recommendations
  • Share insights with marketing and sales teams

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional email marketing experience
  • Hands-on proficiency with at least one major ESP:
    • HubSpot
    • Klaviyo
    • Marketo
    • Mailchimp
    • ActiveCampaign
  • Experience building email campaigns and automated workflows
  • Strong audience segmentation and list management skills
  • Strong email copywriting skills
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email templates
  • Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including:
    • VLOOKUPs
    • Pivot tables
    • Data segmentation
  • Understanding of email marketing metrics and optimization
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing databases of 50K+ contacts
  • Experience with deliverability tools such as:
    • Litmus
    • GlockApps
    • Postmark
  • Experience in SaaS, e-commerce, or B2B services
  • Experience integrating ESPs with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Looker, or marketing dashboards
  • Strong understanding of revenue attribution and lifecycle marketing

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand email as a performance and revenue channel, not simply a communication tool
  • You’re comfortable building campaigns from start to finish
  • You combine strong copywriting with analytical thinking
  • You understand segmentation, automation, and customer lifecycle marketing
  • You pay close attention to deliverability and database health
  • You test continuously and use data to improve performance
  • You’re organized and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing campaign performance and deliverability metrics, then build or optimize an upcoming email campaign.

Throughout the day, you could write email copy, create audience segments, troubleshoot automation workflows, clean contact lists, run A/B tests, and analyze conversion performance.

You’ll also monitor automated nurture sequences and prepare reports showing how email contributes to engagement, conversions, and revenue.

In short: you own the systems, campaigns, automation, and optimization that turn email into a scalable growth channel.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Open rates of approximately 20–40%
  • Click-through rates of approximately 3–5%+
  • Continuous improvement in conversion performance
  • Bounce rates below 2%
  • Unsubscribe rates below 1%
  • Healthy sender reputation and deliverability
  • Clean and accurately segmented contact databases
  • Clear conversion and revenue attribution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of email marketing execution and optimization
  • Direct impact on engagement, conversions, and revenue
  • Opportunity to build sophisticated lifecycle and automation programs
  • Work with leading ESP and marketing automation platforms
  • Data-driven environment focused on testing and measurable results
  • Fully remote role with strong autonomy
  • Growth opportunities into Lifecycle Marketing, CRM Marketing, Marketing Automation, or Growth Marketing

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Pavago Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Email Marketing / Automation Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience with email campaigns, HubSpot or Klaviyo, automation workflows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance optimization, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $7/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions partners with medical practices to provide outsourced nutrition, dietary, exercise, and wellness support to their patients.

Our model allows physician practices to expand the services available to their patients without having to build and manage an entire wellness team internally. Pillar supports the operational infrastructure behind the program, including patient coordination, provider support, scheduling, documentation, communication, reporting, and billing-related workflows.

We are building a model that should feel simple and seamless for the physician practice, even though there are many moving parts behind the scenes.

That is where the Operations Lead comes in.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.

You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.

As Pillar grows, this role should evolve from personally managing many operational processes to building the systems, team structure, accountability, and workflows that allow the company to scale efficiently.

We are looking for someone who does not simply identify problems. You should be able to determine why they are happening, create a practical solution, implement it, and measure whether the solution worked.

What You Will Own

Practice Onboarding & Client Operations

  • Own new practice onboarding from agreement through launch, including referral, scheduling, communication, documentation, and billing-related workflows.

  • Serve as a key operational point of contact for physician partners and practice staff, ensuring requests, concerns, and follow-ups are addressed promptly.

Patient Operations & Engagement

  • Oversee the patient journey from referral through outreach, scheduling, first appointment, and ongoing engagement.

  • Monitor cancellations, no-shows, scheduling delays, and patient drop-off points, then implement workflows to improve conversion and retention.

Provider & Clinical Operations

  • Coordinate operationally with dietitians, exercise professionals, and support staff to maintain appropriate availability, capacity, and coverage.

  • Monitor provider scheduling, patient assignments, operational responsiveness, and adherence to documentation expectations.

Documentation, Billing & Revenue Operations

  • Monitor the timely completion and flow of documentation and billing-related information between providers, Pillar, and partner practices.

  • Investigate operational issues that may delay billing, reimbursement, or revenue and coordinate appropriate resolution.

Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, duplicated work, and failure points, then redesign processes to improve speed, accuracy, and accountability.

  • Build practical SOPs, trackers, dashboards, templates, checklists, and standardized workflows for recurring operational activities.

KPI & Performance Management

  • Track core operational KPIs across referrals, scheduling, patient engagement, provider utilization, documentation, service delivery, and partner performance.

  • Analyze trends and operational gaps to determine what changed, why it changed, and what action should be taken.

  • Provide leadership with concise reporting on performance, risks, unresolved issues, priorities, and recommended next steps.

Technology & AI

  • Evaluate and implement tools that simplify operations, reduce administrative workload, and improve visibility across the business.

  • Use AI and automation to improve reporting, workflow management, analysis, documentation, communication, and recurring operational processes.

Founder & Leadership Partnership

  • Translate leadership priorities and ideas into clear operational plans, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Surface risks and unresolved issues early while bringing recommended solutions instead of only reporting problems.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare operations, medical practice operations, program management, client success, healthcare administration, or a closely related field.

  • Experience owning processes and outcomes rather than only completing assigned administrative tasks.

  • Strong understanding of patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, healthcare administrative workflows, and service operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems, investigate root causes, and independently implement solutions.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with physicians, practice staff, healthcare professionals, patients, and senior leadership.

  • Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, trackers, or operational systems.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with patient information, documentation, billing information, and operational data.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, changing, or early-stage environment.

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, systems, workflows, and processes independently.

  • Practical experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve business processes.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting US medical practices or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience in telehealth, nutrition, wellness, chronic care, preventive health, exercise programs, or virtual healthcare services.

  • Familiarity with healthcare insurance, eligibility, reimbursement, billing, claims, or revenue-cycle workflows.

  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems, scheduling platforms, CRM tools, telehealth systems, or patient communication platforms.

  • Experience coordinating or managing remote healthcare teams.

  • Experience with physician practice onboarding, account management, or client success.

  • Experience building processes or operations within an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

  • Previous ownership of operational KPIs, service-level metrics, or business performance reporting.

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here

You are someone who naturally asks:

What is supposed to happen? What is actually happening? Where is the gap? Why is it happening? Who owns fixing it? How do we prevent it from happening again?

You are proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

You do not need every process to already exist before you can start working. You are comfortable creating structure where structure is missing.

You enjoy both strategy and execution. You can discuss operational priorities with leadership and then personally investigate a scheduling issue, analyze a broken workflow, create a process, or coordinate a solution.

You are comfortable taking ownership without waiting to be repeatedly reminded.

You communicate clearly, escalate thoughtfully, and understand the difference between simply reporting a problem and actually helping solve it.

Most importantly, you think in terms of systems.

When the same issue happens repeatedly, your instinct should not be to keep fixing it manually. Your instinct should be to understand why it keeps happening and build a better process.

What Success Looks Like

During your first few weeks, success will mean developing a strong understanding of Pillar's end-to-end operating model and creating clear visibility into how physician practices, patients, providers, documentation, billing, and internal workflows connect.

You will identify the biggest operational bottlenecks, improve patient and practice workflows, strengthen accountability, establish meaningful operational reporting, and reduce recurring operational issues.

Over time, you will help build an operating system capable of supporting substantially more physician practices, patients, and providers without operational complexity increasing at the same rate as the business.

The ultimate goal is simple:

Create an operation where physician practices receive a reliable experience, patients move through the program smoothly, providers have the support they need, leadership has visibility into performance, and fewer problems require manual intervention as Pillar grows.

A SuperSim é a maior fintech de microcrédito no Brasil. Temos como missão transformar o mercado de crédito online, dando acesso a empréstimos para as classes C e D, pessoas e famílias historicamente pouco atendidas pelo sistema financeiro. Se esse propósito faz seus olhos brilharem, venha ser #SUPERHERO também!

Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior, sua missão será:

Construir soluções de software que coloquem IA generativa no centro dos nossos produtos e da forma como desenvolvemos tecnologia.

Buscamos uma pessoa genuinamente hands-on, que continue escrevendo código de produção e já tenha transformado aplicações com LLM de conceito em sistemas utilizados por usuários reais.

Você terá autonomia para atuar de ponta a ponta, desde decisões de arquitetura até a entrada em produção, assumindo responsabilidade por qualidade, latência, custo, confiabilidade e evolução das soluções.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e colocar em produção sistemas baseados em LLM;
  • Construir soluções envolvendo RAG, agentes e sistemas multiagente, fine-tuning e pipelines de avaliação;
  • Evoluir aplicações de GenAI de prova de conceito para soluções utilizadas por usuários reais;
  • Acompanhar e otimizar custo, latência, qualidade e confiabilidade das aplicações;
  • Criar mecanismos de avaliação sistemática dos sistemas, incluindo golden datasets e abordagens como LLM-as-judge;
  • Definir guardrails e mecanismos que aumentem a segurança e previsibilidade das aplicações;
  • Assumir ownership técnico sobre iniciativas críticas, tomando decisões e avaliando trade-offs de arquitetura;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com Produto e áreas de negócio para transformar problemas reais em soluções de software;
  • Acompanhar os resultados das soluções implementadas e utilizar dados para orientar sua evolução;
  • Atuar diretamente na implementação das soluções, mantendo uma rotina técnica e próxima do código.
  • 7+ anos de experiência construindo software, mantendo atuação técnica e escrevendo código de produção atualmente;
  • Experiência comprovada colocando sistemas baseados em LLM em produção, indo além do uso de ferramentas de assistência à programação;
  • Experiência prática com pelo menos algumas das frentes de RAG, agentes, fine-tuning ou avaliação de sistemas com LLM;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões de arquitetura e avaliar trade-offs relacionados a custo, performance, latência e confiabilidade;
  • Histórico de protagonismo técnico, tendo liderado, criado ou escalado iniciativas críticas com contribuição individual identificável;
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas, ou trajetória que demonstre sólida formação técnica;
  • Autonomia, profundidade técnica, capacidade analítica e orientação a resultados;
Desejáveis:
  • Passagem por startups, empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes com elevada exigência técnica;
  • Experiência trabalhando em estruturas enxutas e com alta autonomia;
  • Produção técnica pública, como projetos open source, artigos, palestras ou conteúdos de engenharia;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre tecnologia, produto e negócio;
  • Histórico de crescimento e aumento de responsabilidade ao longo da carreira.

Informações adicionais

  • Salário competitivo ao mercado;
  • Contratação CLT
  • Bônus anual;
  • SuperSim Flex: nossos benefícios são distribuídos em um programa de pontos e você pode escolher quais fazem mais sentido para você. Dentre as categorias temos Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Transporte ou Vale Mobilidade, Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Educação e Totalpass;
  • Previdência Privada;

  • Treinamentos subsidiados pela empresa;
  • Day Off no dia do seu aniversário;
  • Futebol e Vôlei semanal;
  • Celebrações e Happy Hours comemorativos.

Nossos valores:

raw.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYThis is a client-facing, doer role dedicated to the execution and management of in-person and remote primary qualitative research projects.
raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

This is a client-facing, doer role dedicated to the execution and management of in-person and remote primary qualitative research projects. This specific position - supporting a Fortune 100 technology client - requires a high level of adaptability, including operating in fast-moving client environments, synthesizing and articulating insights in real time, and flexing hours to support global work. It further involves significant travel to qualitative research, confidence managing senior clients, and fluency in applying AI tools to enhance research, analysis, and storytelling.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Project Management

  • Own daily execution of primary, secondary and/or consulting initiatives
  • Ensure cohesive delivery across Insights, ReOps and Creative team members
  • Maintain project team momentum, organization and clarity across all phases

Research Tools

  • Create (or refine drafts of) research tools – discussion guides, questionnaires, activities, stimuli
  • Continuously refine tools based on preliminary findings and evolving learning needs

Fieldwork Execution & Management

  • Serve as primary contact for internal and external project team members
  • Oversee successful quant and/or qual fieldwork – strategically and tactically
  • Moderate/facilitate primary research across qualitative approaches (e.g., interviews, focus groups, ethnographies, diaries, AI-moderated conversations) – both in-person and remote
  • Identify early themes, issues and opportunities and adjust fieldwork/stimuli/topics to maximize learning

Insight Articulation & Storytelling

  • Lead the synthesis of research findings into clear, compelling insights, identifying patterns, tensions and opportunities across qualitative and quantitative data
  • Ensure insights are strategically relevant, human-centered and actionable
  • Own the development of the project’s core narrative and final deliverables
  • Translate findings into implications and recommendations

Disclaimer

These descriptions reflect management’s assignment of essential functions and other anticipated responsibilities; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND LEADERSHIP REQUIREMENTS

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, or equivalent) a plus
  • 6+ years of experience in market research, insights, strategy or consulting environments
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing qualitative and/or quantitative research across a range of methodologies, tools and platforms
  • Proven ability to lead end-to-end research engagements, from design through synthesis and delivery
  • Experience moderating or facilitating qualitative research (e.g., interviews, groups, ethnographies, digital/asynchronous methods)
  • Experience translating data into clear, actionable insights and narratives
  • Experience and savvy in the technology sector

Skills & Competencies

  • Must have high fluency and production abilities in the MS and Google suites of software
  • Must be a regular business user of AI tools and platforms
  • Must balance insights-forward thinking with disciplined execution
  • Must have strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining project clarity and momentum
  • Must be a team-first professional who is a strong collaborator across departments
  • Must be proactive, anticipatory project owner who identifies opportunities to strengthen insights & execution
  • Must be comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving project needs,
  • Must maintain professionalism and flexibility in fast-paced environments
  • Must be open to feedback and able to build on others’ ideas to strengthen project work
  • Must contribute positively to team and company’s culture and energy

PHYSICAL AND/OR COGNITIVE CAPABILITIES REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to work on a company computer using digital platforms and industry-specific software for up to the full duration of the workday
  • Must be able to effectively communicate and exchange information via phone, video, reading, writing, studying, analyzing and entering data
  • Must be able to cognitively process business information, analyze situations and goals, and effectively collaborate with others without creating additional or undue work for others
  • Must be able to travel to in-person research and client/company meetings. Travel may include:
    • Personal (or rented) automobiles
    • Public transportation such as rideshare, train, bus or airplane
    • International travel that requires a valid US passport

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must work from a dedicated, distraction-free, private workspace at home or a space pre-approved by Smarty Pants
  • Core work hours are 9am-5pm EST or 7am-3pm PST Monday-Friday (excluding company closures, PTO, leave). Additional work outside these hours will be required based on client and/or company needs
  • Frequent domestic or international travel may be required to attend research, client meetings or company meetings

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary

  • Competitive salary range available to qualified candidates upon request

Additional Compensation

  • Eligible for discretionary year-end and/or spot bonus, based on company performance and discretion

Benefits

  • Eligible to participate in Smarty Pants’ health care plan offered through Blue Cross/Blue Shield following 60 days of full-time employment
  • Eligible to participate in Smarty Pants-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan following 90 days of full-time employment
  • Employer contribution of 3% of salary to Smarty Pants-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan following one year of employment, with no vesting schedule
  • Eligible for Smarty Pants’ Paid Family Leave Plan following one year of full-time employment
  • Eligible to participate in Smarty Pants’ sponsored 529 savings plan
  • Up to $100/month phone/internet stipend

Plan details are provided separately in the Smarty Pants Employee Handbook and through additional third-party literature.

Paid Time Off

  • Company closures (currently 16.5 weekdays)
  • Up to 17 planned Vacation days
  • Up to 3 unplanned Personal/Bereavement days
  • Unlimited Just Get Better (sick) days
  • Twice-per-quarter half-day Happy Hours

Additional information on PTO usage and limitations is provided in the Smarty Pants Employee Handbook.

Benefits and/or eligibility may change with a 30-day notice to employees.

raw.description:
Position Scope:

This position is responsible for the mobilization and initial engagement of prospective missionary employees, guiding individuals from their first point of contact through the early stages of the application process. With a focus on identifying, recruiting, and encouraging those exploring cross-cultural ministry, the Global Mobilizer plays a vital role in helping raise up new workers for the harvest and shepherding them toward missional service with Communitas.

This role provides leadership in candidate cultivation and recruitment efforts, including building relationships with prospective missionaries, facilitating discernment conversations, maintaining engagement throughout the recruitment pipeline, and ensuring a smooth transition into the formal application process. Working closely with a small team, the Global Mobilizer helps develop and implement strategies that increase awareness of missionary opportunities and identify individuals called to serve internationally.

A key focus of this role is fostering meaningful connections with prospective missionaries while also understanding the ministry needs and opportunities within Communitas fields and projects. Through relational engagement, effective communication, and thoughtful coordination, the Global Mobilizer serves as a bridge between those exploring missionary service and the ministries where God may be calling them to serve.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective missionary candidates.
  • Build relationships with individuals exploring international ministry opportunities.
  • Guide candidates through initial discernment conversations and next steps.
  • Manage and track candidate engagement throughout the recruitment pipeline.
  • Coordinate communication, follow-up, and handoff to the formal application process.
  • Assist in developing and implementing recruitment and mobilization strategies.
  • Represent Communitas at conferences, events, and networking opportunities as needed.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records within applicant tracking and database systems.
  • Collaborate with team members to improve processes and enhance candidate experiences.
  • Support the organization's mission by identifying and encouraging future ministry leaders.

General Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates spiritual maturity and a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.
  • Aligns fully with the mission, vision, values, and Statement of Faith of Communitas.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and integrity in all matters.
  • Maintains a collaborative, learning-oriented, and positive leadership posture.
  • Commits to excellence in communication, stewardship, and organizational representation.

Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience
    • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Communications, Marketing, Psychology, Ministry, or a related field preferred.
    • 1–2 years of leadership, recruiting, ministry, coaching, or related experience.
    • International ministry experience or experience living cross-culturally strongly preferred.
    • Experience working with applicant tracking systems, databases, or CRM platforms preferred.
  • Skills & Competencies
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Strong interpersonal and relational abilities.
    • Effective project management and organizational skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain momentum on ongoing processes.
    • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and geographic locations.
    • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, social media platforms, and cloud-based collaboration tools.
    • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.
    • Flexible and adaptable in a changing work environment.
    • Additional language skills (Spanish, German, or other languages) are highly valued.
  • Spiritual & Personal Characteristics
    • Demonstrate a growing relationship with Jesus Christ and alignment with the mission and values of Communitas.
    • Possess a passion for helping people discern and pursue God’s calling.
    • Maintain a positive, encouraging, and servant-hearted attitude.
    • Be proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.
    • Work with excellence, integrity, and professionalism.
    • Exhibit a teachable spirit and commitment to ongoing personal and professional growth.
    • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.
    • Have a genuine desire to see God glorified among all nations.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed.
  • Reliable internet access and a suitable home office environment for remote work.

Funding:

This position is funded through personal ministry partnership development (support raising), which covers both salary and ministry-related expenses. Individuals who are self-employed or serving in a bi-vocational capacity are encouraged to apply. Communitas provides onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing support to help team members build and sustain a healthy ministry partnership team.

Salary: $45,000-$60,000

EWOR is launching cutting-edge new initiatives, and we are looking for exceptional operators and builders to join our new department.

We are backed and led by serial entrepreneurs, including Paul Müller (founder of Adjust, €1.2B exit) and Petter Made (founder of SumUp, €8B), who have built high-impact technology and category-defining ventures from the ground up.

What We Offer

  • Maximum ownership: Complete autonomy to architect systems, drive strategy, and build from 0 to 1 without corporate red tape.

  • High-growth environment: Complete focus on achieving strong market validation and scalable traction as fast as possible. No PowerPoint presentations, no 7 layers of approval. Good ideas and fast execution are what matter.

  • Elite team: Report directly to the department founder and collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, researchers, and commercial leaders.

  • Competitive compensation & upside: Attractive compensation with equity upside.

Tasks

  • You will lead and execute core 0-to-1 initiatives in cutting-edge domains such as Space Tech.

  • You will translate high-level strategic vision into concrete execution roadmaps, driving rapid implementation from prototype to production.

  • You will architect scalable solutions and drive critical milestones to position the new department for rapid growth and potentially a spin-off to attract institutional backing.

Requirements

Job Title: Line Manager for Clinical Project Management

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About the role

Are you an experienced Clinical Project Manager who enjoys developing others, building strong teams, and helping colleagues succeed?

We are looking for a CPM Line Manager to join our cFSP team and provide leadership, coaching, and functional oversight to an assigned group of Clinical Project Managers.


This opportunity could suit an established people manager, but previous formal line management experience is not essential for the right candidate. We are also keen to hear from high-performing Senior or Lead Clinical Project Managers who have demonstrated leadership through mentoring, coaching, study team oversight, stakeholder management, or similar responsibilities and are ready to take the next step in their career.


The successful candidate will combine a strong clinical project management background with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, a collaborative leadership style, and a genuine passion for developing people.


Experience leading global clinical studies within a sponsor-dedicated/FSP model, CRO, or large pharmaceutical environment will be particularly relevant to this opportunity.


What you will be doing

As a CPM Line Manager, you will provide dedicated line management, leadership, coaching, and functional oversight to an assigned team of Clinical Project Managers within the cFSP model.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting regular 1:1 meetings with direct reports, providing coaching, performance feedback, career development support, and oversight of project responsibilities.
  • Setting clear performance expectations and objectives and supporting ongoing performance management.
  • Coaching and mentoring team members to support their professional growth, leadership development, and longer-term career progression.
  • Leading the onboarding, training, and integration of newly hired CPMs into the cFSP model.
  • Completing and reviewing competency assessments and individual development plans with direct reports.
  • Monitoring team performance, engagement, workload, training completion, and development needs.
  • Supporting employee engagement initiatives and contributing to action planning based on employee feedback.
  • Ensuring CPMs understand their responsibilities within the client-led work package and product delivery model, including appropriate communication, escalation, and adherence to required standards.
  • Ensuring work is conducted in accordance with applicable processes, policies, procedures, quality standards, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Reviewing resource allocation and workload across the CPM team and partnering with leadership on capacity planning, succession planning, and backfill activities.
  • Producing and presenting team status reports, resource summaries, and operational updates for functional and senior leadership.
  • Supporting direct reports with expectations relating to resource management, time reporting, compliance, training, and operational discipline.
  • Partnering with functional leadership, client stakeholders, and operational teams to support effective resource management and clear ways of working.
  • Driving continuous improvement activities and encouraging the sharing of best practices across the CPM team.
  • Representing the CPM line management function during internal meetings, governance discussions, talent reviews, and client-facing forums as required.
  • Supporting recruitment, interviewing, onboarding, and workforce planning activities for the CPM function.
  • Serving as an escalation point for team members and providing guidance on people-related, operational, and resource management challenges.
  • Promoting a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, engagement, and continuous development across the team.
  • Participating in functional, organizational, and client-driven initiatives supporting talent development, resource management, and strategic business objectives.

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone with strong clinical project management experience who can demonstrate both successful project delivery and the ability to lead, influence, and develop others.


You will ideally bring:

  • A Bachelor's degree in life sciences or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of clinical research experience, including minimum 3 years of leadership experience.
  • Strong clinical project management experience, ideally including responsibility for global studies.
  • Experience within a sponsor-dedicated/FSP model, CRO, or large pharmaceutical environment.
  • Previous formal people management experience is valuable, but not essential. Leadership experience gained through mentoring, coaching, study team oversight, or similar responsibilities will also be considered.
  • A strong understanding of clinical trial conduct and applicable clinical research regulatory requirements, including ICH-GCP and relevant local regulations and guidelines.
  • A proven ability to deliver projects successfully against quality and timeline expectations.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills, including the ability to work effectively with clients, colleagues, and senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong coaching, influencing, negotiation, judgment, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Good problem-solving skills and the ability to proactively identify and address performance or operational challenges.
  • The ability to establish effective working relationships across functions and geographies, with awareness and understanding of cultural differences.
  • A collaborative and inclusive leadership style with a genuine interest in supporting the development and success of others.
  • Strong organizational and computer skills, including MS Office applications.

Above all, we are interested in individuals who demonstrate leadership potential, strong stakeholder engagement, sound operational judgment, and a proven track record of successful clinical project delivery.


Ready for your next step?

If you are already an experienced people manager, or an accomplished Clinical Project Manager who has naturally taken on leadership, mentoring, or coaching responsibilities and is now ready to move into formal line management, we would love to hear from you.


This is an opportunity to combine your clinical project management expertise with people leadership, helping a team of CPMs grow, perform, and succeed while contributing to the continued development of our cFSP partnership.


Apply today and take the next step in your leadership journey with IQVIA.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.



This job is curated by Lifelancer.

Lifelancer is a talent-hiring platform in Life Sciences, Pharma and IT. The platform connects talent with opportunities in pharma, biotech, health sciences, healthtech and IT domains.

Please apply via Lifelancer platform to get connected to the application page and to find similar roles.

About Compound Growth Marketing (CGM)

Compound Growth Marketing (CGM) is a marketing consultancy built to help ambitious B2B SaaS and technology companies scale to $100M+ in revenue by building sustainable, repeatable demand generation systems.

We help clients grow by designing and optimizing a Predictable Demand System™, focused on three compounding drivers of growth:

  • Deal Volume
  • Deal Process
  • Actionable Insights

Our work spans go-to-market strategy, paid acquisition, demand capture (SEO & AI-optimized content), funnel automation, and advanced analytics. We partner closely with our clients' revenue, marketing, and operations teams to drive measurable outcomes — not just activity.

Client demand for organic and AI-search visibility (AEO/GEO) is accelerating faster than almost any other channel we run. We're building out the SEO practice to meet that demand with a standardized, scalable delivery model, and we're hiring a Manager to help lead it.

About the Role

The SEO & Content Manager owns SEO and AI-search-visibility (AEO/GEO) strategy for a portfolio of 6–12 B2B client accounts, and owns the output of the analysts who execute against that strategy.

You report to the Head of SEO and work alongside peer Managers within the practice. This is a working-manager role: you lead the work directly — strategy, planning, quality bar — and, as the practice grows, lead a small team of analysts who execute against your plan. We're talking hands-on ownership of both the strategy and the people delivering it, with people-management advancement pathing that grows over time.

This is an ideal role for someone who:

  • Is genuinely excited about where SEO is headed as LLMs reshape search, and already treats AI visibility as essential SEO work rather than an emerging trend
  • Sees SEO in B2B as equal parts technical execution and content strategy, and doesn't need convincing that the technical fundamentals matter just as much as knowing what content will actually earn visibility with the target buyer
  • Gets personal joy from leading others and helping them grow, with a desire to do the hard work of building a team over time
  • Comfortable operating as the subject-matter expert behind the scenes, briefing the Account Manager so they can speak to strategy and results with confidence

What You Do

Strategy & Planning

  • Own SEO and AEO strategy for your portfolio, translating performance data into a prioritized plan for analysts to execute, and adjusting when things change
  • Maintain a forward view of each account's work three to six months out, not just the current sprint
  • Partner with Project Managers to scope planned work against client budgets and team capacity
  • Own content strategy for your portfolio: direct topics, structure, and optimization guidance for analysts to execute

Team Leadership & Ownership of Output

  • Own the output of your analyst team: every audit, brief, technical recommendation, or report that reaches a client reflects your standard and your accountability
  • Coach and develop your analysts, building their skill and judgment so they need less direct oversight over time
  • Take a role in hiring, performance reviews, and promotion or termination decisions for your team, in partnership with the Head of SEO

AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO)

  • Own AI-search-visibility strategy for your portfolio — monitoring how clients show up across ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and comparable surfaces
  • Help define how CGM benchmarks and measures AEO performance for clients, including which tools and metrics actually indicate progress in a space that hasn't standardized on either yet
  • Bring hard evidence to AEO recommendations — what changed, what moved, and why
  • Track how AI search surfaces are evolving and translate that into concrete guidance for clients and analysts

Performance & Client Communication

  • Monitor performance across your portfolio and translate results into next-step recommendations
  • Work hand-in-hand with the Account Manager on client communication, and step into conversations directly as the SME when a client needs that level of depth
  • Escalate findings and plan adjustments to practice leadership when an account needs a second set of eyes

Why Join CGM

  • Step into a practice that's actively being built and standardized — you'll help shape the playbook, not just execute someone else's
  • Real input into how your team grows as CGM's SEO/AEO practice scales
  • Work with B2B technology and SaaS companies at the center of the current AI-search shift
  • Fully remote, flexible culture built around trust and outcomes

Requirements

  • 4+ years of direct SEO experience
  • 2+ years prior agency experience
  • Demonstrated national B2B SEO experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on technical SEO expertise (crawlability, site architecture, schema, page experience)

  • Hands on experience with AI tools like Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Google AI Studio, AirOps, and Profound

Strongly Preferred

Nice-to-Have
