Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

Voices for Healthy Kids, an initiative of the American Heart Association, is seeking a creative, detail‑oriented intern to support our communications and marketing team. This intern will help with design-based work, update and refresh outreach materials, and ensure brand consistency across digital and print assets. It’s a hands-on opportunity to build design and communications skills while supporting national advocacy efforts to improve child and family health.

The American Heart Association’s Internship Program provides college students an opportunity for hands-on experience in various facets for individuals interested in gaining work experience with a non-profit, voluntary health organization.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as training and support locally and through our National Center.#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Internship Overview:

  • Time Commitment: 20 hours per week
  • Internship Duration: 1/25/27-5/7/27​
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary: $23.00 per hour

Internship Outcomes:

Individuals participating in the internship program are provided with an opportunity to:

  • Gain important and practical job skills to be successful in a non-profit environment.
  • Opportunity to explore a career-path with a reputable voluntary health/service organization.
  • Complete an internship that enriches your academic and professional resume as well as enriching your personal life by making a difference in the lives of others.

Responsibilities

  • Review, update, and refresh existing communications materials to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency across print and digital assets.
  • Design new content—such as one-pagers, social graphics, slide templates, and toolkits—supporting Voices for Healthy Kids advocacy and outreach efforts.
  • Ensure all materials align with Voices for Healthy Kids brand guidelines, including visual identity, tone, and messaging.
  • Support layout and design work, applying established templates and brand standards to new and existing materials.
  • Fact-check language, data points, and citations to ensure materials are accurate, up to date, and grounded in research.
  • Collaborate with the communications and marketing team to refine content and support timely project updates.

Qualifications

  • College seniors and graduate students pursuing a degree in public policy, communications, public relations, public health, journalism or related fields.
  • Experience in public policy and/or an interest in non-profit and health care communications is strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication, writing, editing, and proofreading skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage projects from start to finish, including planning, execution, and follow-through.
  • Interest in translating complex information into clear, easy-to-understand content for different audiences.
  • Proficiency in Canva and other tools used to create clear, engaging communications materials.
  • Must be familiar with software including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Required Equipment: Reliable Wi-Fi connection.
  • Minimum availability of 20 hrs/wk, M-F between the hours of 9am-5pm.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship, now or in the future. For any roles working remotely, the work must also be performed inside the United States, not in a foreign country.

Compensation & Benefits

The job application window is expected to close: October 23, 2026.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation and Performance – Attracting talented, committed interns means offering competitive compensation, ongoing professional development and training, and an environment in which to work and grow. And we do.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Healthcare Benefits – You will have the opportunity to participate in our Teladoc General Medical and Behavioral Health programs. We also provide access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost as a confidential program designed to assist employees and family members with personal issues that affect their relationships at home or at work.

Apply Today:So, are you ready to intern for the largest voluntary health organization dedicated to fighting heart disease, stroke, and other cardiovascular diseases?

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

raw.description:
Client Partner – Financial Services
Vertical Relevance | Business Development | 2026

Job Summary

The Client Partner (CP) is a strategic, quota-carrying role focused on growing Vertical Relevance’s business in financial services. You will find and close professional services engagements, build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, and position Vertical Relevance as the partner of choice for AWS cloud and AI transformation. Our model is domain-led, agentic by design, and platform-backed: financial services advisory, agentic AI delivery, and AWS cloud and AI platform engineering.
This role requires a proven track record of selling professional services into financial services firms, including cloud services built on AWS. Vertical Relevance is an AWS Premier Tier Partner, and the CP sells across all seven of our AWS practice competencies, from platform foundations, security, and resiliency through application modernization, data, and AI. GenAI and agentic AI, delivered with AWS and our Anthropic partnership, are a growing part of the portfolio, and the CP should be able to hold a credible conversation about them.

Our Seven AWS Competencies

The Client Partner is expected to understand each competency well enough to find the opportunity, frame the business case, and bring in the competency lead to shape the solution.
  • Enterprise Program Governance / PMO: Program and engagement management, IT transformation, mergers and acquisitions, and integration offices for large cloud programs
  • DevOps: DevOps platforms that deliver infrastructure and deployment pipelines through automation, including account, network, pipeline, and container foundations
  • Security & Compliance: SecOps platforms that deliver security and compliance policies as code, including identity and control foundations, policy as code, and our Control Broker asset
  • SRE & Resiliency: Monitoring, observability, and automated resiliency testing, including game days, chaos experiments, and performance testing for critical workloads
  • App Modernization: Re-designing, re-factoring, and re-platforming applications to run AWS-native, including monolith-to-microservices and migration programs
  • Data & Analytics: DataOps platforms for data ingestion, governance, and analytics, including lakehouse, data mesh, data marketplace, and catalog work
  • AI: Designing, building, and tuning AI, GenAI, and agentic AI solutions on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker) and with Anthropic Claude
Each competency is backed by 35+ AWS reusable solution accelerators (playbooks, blueprints, modules, and libraries) that shorten timelines and reduce risk. The CP uses these assets to differentiate Vertical Relevance in every pursuit.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development
  • Identify and close new professional services opportunities across banks, asset and wealth managers, insurers, and payments firms
  • Build pipeline across all seven AWS competencies, and connect opportunities across them (for example, a migration that leads to security, resiliency, and data work)
  • Use personal networks, AWS account teams, and internal relationships to generate qualified pipeline
  • Run the pursuit from first meeting through executive briefings, assessments, proofs of value, and SOW
Direct Sales, AWS Partnership & Co-Sell (in priority order)
  • 1. Lead direct sales: Own and lead direct sales with financial services clients: originate opportunities, run the pursuit, build the relationship with the economic buyer, and close the SOW. Direct selling is the core of this role and the primary measure of success.
  • 2. Work the AWS partnership: Work closely with AWS account managers, partner development managers, and AWS field teams. Build joint account plans, use AWS funding and buying programs such as MAP, proof-of-concept funding, and AWS Marketplace, and position Vertical Relevance’s AWS Premier Tier status and competencies (Financial Services, Security, DevOps, Resilience, and GenAI).
  • 3. Co-sell with partners: Run co-sell motions with partners, including AWS ProServe engagements and staffing requests through the AWS partner delivery process, and joint pursuits with Anthropic and other technology partners.
GenAI & Agentic AI
  • Identify where GenAI and agentic AI create value for clients, such as operations, reconciliation, vulnerability management, software engineering productivity, and client service
  • Position our GenAI Center of Excellence, agentic reconciliation, and AI-driven vulnerability management (Mythos/Glasswing) offerings, delivered with AWS and Anthropic
  • Address the questions financial services buyers ask about AI: model risk, data privacy, security, controls, and regulatory expectations
Client Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers at target accounts, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, and business line heads
  • Position Vertical Relevance as a strategic partner for business and technology consulting
  • Manage client relationships through the full sales cycle and into delivery
Collaboration & Strategy
  • Work with delivery teams to build competitive proposals, estimates, and SOWs
  • Build joint go-to-market plans with our technology partners, including AWS, Anthropic (Claude), and ServiceNow
  • Bring in competency leads and solution architects at the right moment to shape solutions, demos, and proposals
  • Drive account planning to expand within existing clients and win new logos
Sales Execution
  • Manage multiple deal cycles at once while keeping pipeline and forecast data accurate in the CRM
  • Meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas through strategic, outcome-based engagements
  • Grow accounts through a steady series of follow-on SOWs and change requests, using each delivered engagement to open the next
  • Restructure scope and pricing when a client’s budget or priorities shift, so the deal stays alive without giving up agreed principles
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle past signature: client procurement and vendor risk steps, resource requests, onboarding, billing start, milestone invoicing, and collections
Leadership & Advocacy
  • Act as a trusted advisor who understands each client’s business challenges and offers tailored solutions
  • Represent Vertical Relevance at industry events, executive roundtables, and partner forums to build brand awareness and thought leadership in financial services cloud and AI

What Great Looks Like Day to Day

Our best Client Partners share a set of daily habits. We are looking for someone who already works this way.
  • Runs every meeting with purpose. Every client meeting has a written agenda sent in advance and an internal prep session. Within hours of the call, a recap goes out with decisions, owners, and target dates.
  • Keeps a steady executive cadence. Sends a weekly executive status report to the client sponsor ahead of the standing call, and sets up short, frequent touchpoints to drive contracts and onboarding through to closure.
  • Captures and shares account intelligence. Writes up what was heard, the business problem behind it, the opportunity for Vertical Relevance, and specific next steps. Turns a single conversation into a working account plan.
  • Multi-threads every account. Builds relationships across the CIO, CTO, CISO, Chief Data Officer, head of cloud, and business sponsors, and tracks reorganizations, budget changes, and who influences each decision.
  • Leads with the client’s problem. Frames the opportunity as an end-to-end business outcome, not another tool or dashboard, and points to where agentic AI removes manual work.
  • Invests in face time. Plans onsite working sessions that pair tactical delivery support with strategic planning for the next phase, such as agentic process transformation.
  • Brings the right people in. Pulls in solution architects and security or AI experts to debrief and shape the pursuit, and brings in Vertical Relevance founders for senior client conversations.
  • Follows through relentlessly. Chases the open item personally, whether it’s a signature, a start date, a background check, or an overdue invoice, and doesn’t let it sit.
  • Uses judgment and discretion. Knows when to respond and when to let the client sponsor handle an internal issue, and protects confidential information about client people and politics.
  • Credits the team. Recognizes the delivery team’s work with clients and internally, and treats delivery as part of the sale.

Skills & Qualifications

Experience
  • Required: Minimum of 3 years selling professional services (consulting, systems integration, or technology services) into the financial services industry. Software or product-only sales experience does not meet this requirement.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience selling AWS cloud services, such as platform foundations, DevOps, security and compliance, resiliency, migration and modernization, data and analytics, or AI engagements.
  • Required: Track record of leading direct sales with financial services clients as the primary relationship owner, not only through partner-sourced deals
  • Experience working with AWS partnership teams (account managers, partner development managers, AWS programs and funding)
  • Active or past responsibility for co-selling with partners such as AWS ProServe or Anthropic is a plus
  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding quotas for professional services, including scoping engagements, pricing time-and-materials and fixed-fee work, and closing SOWs
Knowledge Required: Our Three Practice Pillars
Vertical Relevance goes to market as “Domain-led. Agentic by design. Platform-backed.” The Client Partner must be able to explain all three pillars, show how they connect in a single client program, and know when to bring in each practice lead.
  • 1. Financial Services Advisory (the domain layer): Enough financial services and regulatory fluency to lead the business conversation: AI value and strategy (use-case portfolios, value roadmaps, and operating model change for AI adoption); governance, risk, and regulatory work (GRC and regulatory remediation, model and agent governance frameworks); program leadership (transformation and integration offices, agile requirements and delivery management); and data strategy (data management and architecture for AI).
  • 2. Agentic AI Delivery (what we build): Enough understanding of production AI to sell it credibly and qualify it honestly: taking agentic pilots to production (for example, a 90-day agentic pilot on Amazon Bedrock); human-in-the-loop design with full audit lineage; financial services domain agents such as trading-desk and RFQ automation, risk and pricing analytics, and risk, surveillance, and regulatory-reporting agents; and vulnerability remediation at scale, including AI-accelerated discovery, triage, and remediation, legacy code remediated with Claude on Amazon Bedrock, and governed post-patch regression testing.
  • 3. AWS Cloud & AI Platform Engineering (where it runs): Solid working knowledge of AWS in regulated industries, across our seven competencies: AWS cloud transformation (migrations, landing zones and Control Tower, cloud security, compliance, and data-perimeter engineering, data and analytics platforms); modernization and resilience (application modernization to cloud- and AI-native, SRE and resiliency engineering); AI foundations on AWS (Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore architectures, Claude deployed in the client’s own AWS environment); and enablement (AWS- and Anthropic-certified delivery teams, co-funded delivery through AWS partner programs, and agent governance for identity, permissions, and audit).
  • Bringing it together: Ability to connect the pillars into one story. For example: a regulatory or risk problem (Pillar 1) is solved with a governed agentic workflow (Pillar 2) running on a secure, resilient AWS platform (Pillar 3).
  • Differentiators: Ability to position our differentiators: 20+ years leading tier-1 financial services transformation, AWS Premier Tier Services Partner status with co-funded solutions, agentic AI in production on Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude, proprietary reusable solution accelerators (RSAs), and human-in-the-loop design with audit lineage a regulator can follow.
Other Qualifications
  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in business terms at every level of an organization
  • Familiarity with business development methods, including technology roadmaps, assessments, and proofs of value
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degrees or certifications in cloud (e.g., AWS), AI, or related fields are a plus

Industry & Solution Focus

  • Financial Services: Wealth Management, Asset Management, Insurance, Banking, Cards / Payments
  • AWS Cloud Transformation: Enterprise Program Governance / PMO, DevOps, Security & Compliance, SRE & Resiliency, App Modernization, Data & Analytics, and AI
  • Artificial Intelligence: GenAI and agentic AI with Amazon Bedrock and Anthropic Claude
  • Client Solutions: ServiceNow

Why Join Vertical Relevance?

At Vertical Relevance, you’ll work alongside industry experts who average more than 20 years of financial services experience, and alongside AWS practitioners who build cloud platforms, modernize applications, and deploy GenAI and agentic AI for some of the largest firms in the industry. We offer a collaborative environment focused on delivering meaningful results for clients while fostering professional growth for our people.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you'll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

The Director, Business Development (DBD) is responsible for market expansion, pipeline development, and revenue growth across pharmacy, PBM, and pharmacy-adjacent market segments. The DBD will independently identify, pursue, and lead outbound business development efforts to form lasting and productive contract relationships with strategic target customers. The DBD is expected to maintain deep market expertise to develop and execute BD strategy to identify and contract new use-case innovations, prove their value, and generate new revenue and commercial opportunities. The DBD will help shape market strategy, originate new commercial opportunities through discovery, and contribute to DrFirst’s growth engine.

The ideal DBD is a market-maker and category-builder with a deep expertise in medication management, pharmacy, and PBM ecosystems who can enter a nascent market segment and drive it to scale. This person is a hunter, self-starter, with a disciplined approach to business development strategy and execution. They prospect relentlessly, build conviction-driven business cases, negotiate complex agreements, and drive deals to close with urgency. Succes is measured by contracting high-value prospects for key products/services with terms and execution plans that accelerate time-to-market, user adoption, and market share. This role demands the discipline to manage a rigorous BD process, the influence to command executive-level conversations, and the ownership mindset to treat Gadget’s commercial success as a personal mandate. This position reports directly to the Executive Vice President.

Who will love this job

  • A driver who works with purpose and passion; someone who will elevate our team through new perspectives, ideas, and solutions.
  • A pharmacy and PBM market expert who brings deep, current knowledge of pharmacy, PBM, and medication management ecosystems and can immediately identify high impact market entry points.
  • A healthcare sales veteran who understands challenges, trends, and opportunities in the healthcare market and how HIT vendors serve this market.
  • A proven consultative sales performer who can influence and deliver value to customer executives and exceed growth-minded company revenue goals.
  • A market expander who can independently identify and break into new pharmacy and PBM market segments, building DrFirst’s commercial presence in white space before the competition recognizes the opportunity.
  • A channel expert who understands how to build mutually beneficial and lasting relationships with channel customers, including ongoing collaboration on solution enhancements that drive joint success.
  • A strategic opportunist who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly from market insight to commercial action, and consistently finds the angle that turns a complex healthcare challenge into a growth opportunity.
  • A builder that enjoys developing new business opportunities, strategies, and solutions with Pharmacy, PBM, and HIT vendors.
  • A trusted advisorand leader who sets a high personal bar for learning and growing in knowledge and skill to help customers and DrFirst improve and grow.
  • A collaborator who recognizes the value of working with key stakeholders across the organization developing the go-to market solution, messaging and business models that position DrFirst competitively to accelerate winning market share and profitability.

What you will work on

What you will work on

  • Solution Sell: This position is responsible to drive contract success with strategic Pharmacy, PBM, and HIT vendors for DrFirst solutions. This means being a high-activity BD leader that understands the right items to spend their time on, building and managing pipeline and effective use of DrFirst resources to achieve success.
  • Grow the Business: We’re a growth company with large opportunities to capture. This role will require deep and creative thinking to achieve market-leading results with new partners and in brand-new to mature market segments.
  • Deliver Results: The ability to clearly see the right goals, develop strategies, deliver the right execution plan and manage to desired results. Being skilled at managing competing priorities, pivoting, and adjusting quickly, and thinking about the big picture are keys to success.
  • Problem solving: The problems we are solving for the industry and with our customers are unique and complex. This takes critical thinking, root cause analysis, and issue dissection with the team to come up with the best solution.
  • Architect Deal Structures: Identify value propositions, use cases, pricing models, and partner configurations that do not fit a standard playbook. You will define the deal structures, bundle logic, and commercial terms that make each partner relationship viable and scalable by bringing together product, legal, and finance to close with speed and precision.
  • Collaborate: Our best work is done when we seek and leverage the ideas, skills, and capacity of our peers to achieve more. In this role, you will need to work well across functional and executive teams to develop the best strategies, plan and accelerate results.
  • Own Your Book of Business: You will be held to a defined book of business — a portfolio of strategic partnerships that you are personally responsible for originating, developing, and growing. You do not wait to be assigned accounts or told which markets to enter. You identify the opportunity, make the case, and go get it.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 10+ years BD management and individual contributor sales experience with direct Pharmacy, PBM, pharmacy system vendor, and HIT Companies within the e-prescribing and healthcare industry
  • Demonstrated success identifying, analyzing and developing new markets to enter with company solutions to create new revenue streams and sustained performance
  • Consistent proven BD performer that meets or exceeds quarterly and annual revenue goals
  • Proven success with solution sales of complex software products/services in the pharmacy, PBM, and HIT market
  • Understanding of sales operations and leveraging CRM tools for pipeline management, sales activity and insights that help manage a high-performing and highly effective BD team
  • Experience negotiating contract and business terms for complex business opportunities
  • Demonstrated sales/marketing expertise and experience developing marketing programs for reseller channels that lead to improved sales results
  • Have prior success at a company with an entrepreneurial, high-growth and collaborative culture
  • Demonstrated experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders and cross functional teams including marketing, product, account management and finance teams
  • Led the development of financial models, pricing strategies and business plans in collaboration with executive, finance, product, and operations teams
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills are a must, as well as the ability to present solutions effectively to partners or business development targets

Physical Requirements

  • 60% interaction remotely via phone and web conference meetings
  • 40% travel to customers, events, and DrFirst offices

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, with a base salary up to $175,000 (Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience)
  • Eligible for Commission, depending on individual performance and quarterly sales results
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K eligible after 3 months of employment, with 50% company match up to first 5% of salary contributed to the plan with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • HSA for eligible employees enrolled in the HDHP, with a generous company contribution up to $500 for individual coverage and $1000 for family coverage per year
  • 100% company paid short and long-term disability, AD&D, and group life insurance
  • Accrued annual paid time off (PTO) of 18 days for the first 3 years of service, increasing thereafter and 7 paid holiday days
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Continuing Education funds up to $1,500 annually for eligible programs after 1 year of service
  • Voluntary benefits including FSA, Hospital indemnity, Accident and Critical Illness insurances

DrFirst is committed to being a Remote-First company, creating a dynamic and flexible workplace where everyone thrives, no matter where they log in from. Check out our approach to remote work:

Our recruitment process at DrFirst is straightforward and secure. You will only be contacted by our recruitment team through an official @drfirst.com email address. We will never ask you for payment or sensitive personal information, such as your social security number or banking details, at any stage of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not request that you purchase equipment or accept e-checks or checks for deposit. If you encounter any communications claiming to be from DrFirst that seem suspicious, please contact our recruitment team directly at to verify the message's authenticity. Your security is important to us!

Learn more about our benefits and professional development opportunities:

raw.description:
Get To Know Us!

WebTPA, a GuideWell Company, is a healthcare third-party administrator with over 30+ years of experience building unique benefit solutions and managing customized health plans.

What is your impact?

The RN Case Manager primary responsibility is to create, implement, and monitor treatment plans to assist patients/members in meeting their healthcare goals. You would use knowledge of healthcare and social services to assess needs and provide interdisciplinary care options in treatment planning for the member. This would include understanding the member's healthcare benefits and healthcare best practices needed for effective treatment planning.

Hours: Monday to Friday 8am - 5pm Central Time

What Will You Be Doing:

  • Case Management process includes assessing the member’s health status and care coordination needs. Can include inpatient review and discharge planning, as well as possible outpatient management.
  • Contact with patient, family, physicians, additional health care providers, and community resources. Contact with provider business offices and with the employer/client may also be required.
  • Identification of alternative treatment plans, which would have to be approved by all parties. These alternative care plans will be based on quality care within cost containment guidelines, allowing available claims dollars to be used in the most judicious manner possible.
  • Assessment of the clinical status and resultant sequela to coordinate the most appropriate service to meet the individual’s health care needs. The Case Manager will then monitor the health status and the impact of the treatment plan for each client. The Case Manager will be responsible for altering the care plan as deemed appropriate by the dynamic, ever-changing client needs.
  • Identification of services, resources, providers, and facilities that could best serve members in a timely and cost-effective manner, to promote optimum value for the client and reimbursement source.
  • Development and implementation of Case Management goals, both short and long term, with documented care plans.
  • Utilize technology/resources to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of the elected treatment plan, pre-implementation and post-implementation. This outcome measurement will be used in determining the effective results and in establishing future patient-centered care plans.
  • Accurate and timely reporting as deemed appropriate by each client member.
  • Medical record review to determine medical necessity of requested services.
  • Interpreting individual health plans and authorizing/coordinating care in accordance with plan provisions.

What You Must Have:

  • 5+ years related work experience with a professional background in clinical nursing and patient assessment.
  • Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience
  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing
  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure
  • Compact State Licensure in good standing.
  • Knowledgeable in medical terminology, reasonable and necessary treatment plans, delivery quality health care services and cost containment practices.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-operational areas within the organization.

What We Prefer:

  • (CCM) Certified Case Manager
  • Prior experience in utilization management or case management preferred, preferably within the managed care environment
  • Intensive care or higher-acuity patient experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of managed care in a self-funded employer population is preferred.
  • Ability to identify problems such as underutilization or overutilization of services
  • Ability to promote and maintain quality care through analysis

What We Can Offer YOU!

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As a WebTPA employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, Short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan includes employer contribution and employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, and 11 holidays
  • Additional voluntary benefits available and a comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for interns and part-time employees may differ.

General Physical Demands:

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

raw.description:
At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.

Ours is a culture of empowerment – one that believes in effort, results, and accountability. We believe that transparency fosters trust, trust fosters growth, and that growth drives innovation. Our commitment to rigorous evaluation and relentless execution lead to rapid evolution.

We answer only to the small business owners we serve, and this independence allows us to stay focused on what matters most: helping their businesses thrive by providing expert guidance and best-in-class insurance policies.

We’re growing fast and want you to be a part of it!

Veracity is looking for a Director of Product, Insurance Platform – a product leader who has built and managed complex, regulated business systems in production. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will lead the product team responsible for the technology that supports how we launch insurance products, serve customers, and operate our business.

Our platform rebuild is underway. This remote role will help shape its direction, guide delivery, and lead the transition from existing systems. You will bring practical experience making technology work in production within a regulated industry and improving it as business needs evolve.

You will lead a small team of product managers and work closely with Engineering, Program Management, Product Marketing, and Operations. Program Management and Product Marketing own insurance product strategy and commercial performance; your team owns the platform capabilities that support them.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Roadmap

  • Set the platform product vision and roadmap, connecting business priorities to clear, achievable plans
  • Own the ongoing improvement of the platform – using adoption, reliability, delivery speed, and business results to guide priorities
  • Make it easier to launch and manage insurance products by simplifying workflows and expanding shared capabilities

Delivery & Engineering Partnership

  • Lead the rebuild and migration of existing products and workflows while supporting ongoing business operations – bringing practical experience making insurance technology work in production and improving it as business needs evolve
  • Partner with Engineering to build reliable, adaptable systems and evaluate when to build, buy, or improve existing technology

Business & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Work closely with Engineering, Program Management, Product Marketing, and Operations to align platform capabilities with business needs – your team owns the platform capabilities that support them; Program Management and Product Marketing own insurance product strategy and commercial performance
  • Work with business teams to understand customer and operational needs and turn them into useful platform capabilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small team of product managers while staying involved in discovery, major decisions, and delivery
  • Required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of product management experience with at least 2–3 years in a product leadership or senior IC role
  • Direct experience building and managing complex, regulated business systems in production – with clear examples of your role and the outcomes you drove
  • Strong product management experience including setting direction, prioritizing competing needs, and delivering complex initiatives

raw.description:
About Zapata Quantum

Zapata Quantum is shaping the future of quantum computing: setting the standards for what’s viable, valuable, and worth building. The Company powers quantum applications across cryptography, pharmaceuticals, finance, materials discovery, defense, and beyond, translating cutting-edge research into real-world impact.

Zapata is the only organization to have contributed across every technical area of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking program, giving it a uniquely comprehensive view of what it takes to make quantum computing work in practice. Now restructured and sharply focused, Zapata Quantum stands alone as the only publicly traded, pure-play quantum software company fully dedicated to unlocking quantum’s commercial potential.

We’re rebuilding at a pivotal moment for the industry—bringing together a team that will help define how quantum delivers value in the real world, with the opportunity for meaningful ownership as we shape the commercial path forward.

About the role

We are seeking a Quantum Solutions Engineer to work directly with clients to solve real-world problems with quantum computing. This role sits at the intersection of customer engagement and applied quantum engineering—partnering with clients to understand their use cases, then designing, developing, testing, and benchmarking the quantum algorithms and workflows that turn those use cases into deliverable solutions.

You will own end-to-end technical engagements: scoping problems with customers in domains such as cryptography, chemistry, finance, materials discovery, and defense; translating them into concrete quantum circuits and workflows; performing rigorous resource estimation on both near-term and fault-tolerant hardware; and communicating results clearly back to stakeholders. You will partner closely with quantum software engineers, research scientists, and domain experts, and contribute to deliverables for government and commercial programs.

This position offers a high level of individual ownership and is well-suited to engineers who are comfortable working independently within a small, focused team and engaging directly with technical and business stakeholders. This position is classified as exempt under applicable wage and hour laws.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with clients to scope, develop, test, and deliver quantum proof-of-concept and production engagements that demonstrate measurable value for their use cases
  • Develop, implement, and test quantum algorithms and end-to-end workflows for applications in cryptography, chemistry, finance, materials science, and defense
  • Perform end-to-end resource estimation for quantum workloads on both near-term (NISQ) and fault-tolerant hardware architectures, and communicate trade-offs to clients
  • Build, benchmark, and harden circuit compilation, error mitigation, and algorithmic primitives in service of client deliverables
  • Translate customer and domain-specific problems into well-posed quantum computational tasks and reproducible workflows
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact during client engagements, communicating progress, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Contribute to technical reports, customer-facing deliverables, peer-reviewed publications, and government program deliverables
  • Partner with internal software engineers and scientists to improve the quality, correctness, and performance of product and solution deliverables
  • Independently analyze complex scientific and engineering problems and drive them to a working, validated solution

Qualifications

  • PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience delivering quantum solutions
  • Deep understanding of quantum computing fundamentals, including the circuit model, quantum error correction, and complexity theory
  • Hands-on experience developing and testing quantum algorithms and primitives (e.g., QPE, VQE, QAOA, Hamiltonian simulation, amplitude amplification, block encoding)
  • Practical experience building quantum workflows and performing resource estimation for realistic problem instances
  • Strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, probability, and numerical methods
  • Proficiency with quantum-related programming and tooling (e.g., circuit simulation, compilation, resource estimation, scientific computing, or modern quantum SDKs)
  • Track record of peer-reviewed publications, preprints, open-source contributions, or equivalent technical output
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage clients directly and articulate technical results to both scientific and commercial stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, scope open-ended problems, and manage client deliverables with minimal oversight
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and a drive to use them to make solution development and delivery more efficient

Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, applied science, technical consulting, or similar)
  • Experience contributing to government-funded quantum research programs
  • Track record of designing and implementing novel quantum algorithms, demonstrated through publications, preprints, or open-source contributions
  • Deep expertise in either quantum chemistry or quantum cryptography
  • Experience leading proof-of-concept engagements from problem scoping through validated deliverable

The Cyera partnership represents a key growth relationship in the data security space with strong joint GTM momentum. The ideal candidate brings deep experience managing strategic alliances within the cybersecurity industry, a strong co-sell track record, and genuine passion for building partnerships that create measurable outcomes for joint customers.

About the Company:

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Elementary Fine Arts - College Lesson Editor

We are seeking detail‑oriented **Elementary Fine Arts experts** to review and revise college-level lessons. You will check to confirm the accuracy and clarity of lessons to ensure our content is a great resource for students.

This is a remote contractor role. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes.

All work is paid hourly.

Job Description:


The subject-matter expert will carefully perform accuracy checks on provided college-level lessons. Minor edits may be required if the lesson is inaccurate in any way, and the expert must be capable of confirming that lessons are coherent and helpful for our users.

What You’ll Do

- Follow internal documentation to improve content accuracy and quality of provided lessons
- Review and approve college-level lessons in **Elementary Fine Arts**
- Verify content is accurate, on-level, and appropriate for the related course

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Subject-matter expertise in **Elementary Fine Arts**
- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Ability to work independently and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications

- A bachelor’s degree in **Elementary Education or Art**
- 3-5 years of teaching experience in **Elementary Fine Arts**
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree **Elementary Education or Art**
- College teaching experience **Elementary Education or Elementary Fine Arts**
- Experience with content management systems

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.
